tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa bzhugs/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan blo gros dhīḥlas byung ba gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang mdzes pa'i sku/ /chu skyes bsil zer can dbus skyil mo krung bcas ¡Ã kun nas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - kun nas ) rol pa'i 'gying bag can/ /gur gum mdog can zur phud lnga pa snyan gong ut+pal gyis mdzes shing*/ /sna tshogs rin chen rab spras lha yi na bzas smad g.yogs legs par bgos/ /phyag g.yas mkha' ltar sngo ba'i ral gri tsha zer can 'od rab 'phros pas/ /mun pa'i thibs po dral zhing bdud bcom de bzhin nyid don thugs chud cing*/ /g.yon gyi ut+pal 'dab brgyad rnam rgyas mgul pa'i ngos su rab rgyas pa/ /ge sar snying po dri med steng na rgyal ba'i gsung rab glegs bam bsnams/ khyod gtsug mi bskyod skyob pas rab mtshan rdo rje rnon po yi ge drug /bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs can gyi zhabs rdul yid 'ong kho bo'i spyi bor zhog khyod sku bdag lus snying gi 'khor lor rnam bsams gang gi chags sdang sogs/ /ngan sems tha chad dam pas smad pa de kun mgon pos bzod mdzod cig /rgyal sras thu bo'i rnam thar zab cing rgya che bdag la nyer stsol mdzod | | yab gcig nyid las lha gzhan dag la re ba ma 'chis skal ngan bdag | nyin mtshan kun tu 'jam dbyangs gus pas bsams kyang khyed kyi thugs rje'i shugs/ /cung zad med snyam 'on kyang byur ngan rang gi nyes pas bslad par zad/ /da dung khyod mnyes ma gyur bar du skyabs gzhan 'tshal ( ¡¶ lu ¡· tshol ) bar ma gyur cig / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dus rnams kun tu khyaid kyi thugs rjes kun nas kun tu 'dzin gyur cig/ ) bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bstod pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

/ srid pa'i 'khri shing dra ba dral mdzad de/ /yon tan rgya mtsho zhi lam mchog sgrogs pa | | rkang gnyis dbang po nye bar brnyes pa yi/ /go 'phang dam pa thob par mdzad pa rgyal/ /blo gros dpag yas tshig gi gter mnga' ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ /chos rje dpal ldan chos kyi rgya mtsho yi/ /rnam thar me tog gus pas brgyu bar bya/ khyod ni sbyangs pa'i shes bya la/ /rnam par mkhas pa lta ci smos/ /yang dag tshig 'bru don bcas gzhan/ /'thad bcas mkhyen pa ngo mtshar che/ /gang zhig phun tshogs mi zad mnga'/ /de ¡Ã la'ang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· yang ) 'jig rten spyod mi 'jug /de gcig kho nar ma zad de/ /spraus bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi tshig don 'di la rgyu/ /tha dad yod ces gang gsungs pa/ /de la mkhas pa bye bas kyang*/ /chos dang mthun par brgal mi nus | | mnal tshe chos rnams glegs bam gyi/ /tshul gyis khong du chud gyur pa// de yi mod la chos kun gyi/ /de nyid gzigs pa khyod la 'dud/ /ye shes sems dpa'i mtshan brjod la/ /yang srid rnam pa bdun dag tu/ /legs par sbyangs pas skye ba 'dir/ /rang byung nyid du ( ¡¶ lu ¡· kyis ) mngon rtogs gyur/ /de la rtog ge bdag 'dra yi/ /blo yang the tshom mi 'jug ste/ /gtan tshigs bzang po dang ldan pa/ /de bas khyod la bstod phyag 'tshal/ /gang phyir rtog ge la sbyangs shing*// sgra la rnam par mkhas pas kyang*/ khyod kyi gsung la skyon 'di zhes/ /chos bzhin brgal du ma mchis pa/ /de nyid phyir na khyod kyi thugs/ /rnam par dag par kho bos 'tshal/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis rnam kun tu/ /bsngags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gting dpag dka' ba'i chos la yang*/ khyod kyis 'di las mi 'da' zhes/ /nges par gsung ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'byung ) ba de las gzhan/ /mdo sde rnams las de bzhin 'byung*/ /de 'dra kho na legs gsungs pas/ khyod gsung thub pa kho na 'dra/ /bskal ba'i don yang legs gzigs pas/

/dpang gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yi ges 'dul la yi ge dang*/ /rtsis pa rnams la rtsis dang ni// 'tsho byed rnams la 'tsho byed gzhung*/ /chos 'dod rnams la chos kyang ston/ / gang gis phan dgongs thugs rje yis/ /nye bar phan la de ston pa/ /ston mchog khyod 'dra ma mthong ste/ /kun mkhyen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi legs bshad seng ge'i sgra/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin gtso/ /lto 'phye'i dbang pos nyer bsten cing*/ /rgyal ba yis kyang mthun par bsngags ( ¡¶ lu ¡· gsungs ) / /de slad khyaud kyi rnam thar la/ /dad pas 'jug pa smos ci 'tshal/ khums pa de dag dge spyad na/ /kun nas don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal/ /sdom brtson khyod ni thos pa dang | | don yod mthong na nyams su 'phel/ /bsten na dge legs rin chen gter | | stsol mdzad gcig pur gyur pa lags/ /yon tan med la sgro btags nas | | skye bo ngan rnams yon tan sgrogs/ /yon tan can khyod mkhas rnams kyis | | yon tan bsgrags pa khyod la 'dud/ /mang du thos pas blo gsal ba/ / grags ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dregs ) ldan sdom brtson dbang rnams kyi/ /blo gros mthong bas khyod la slar/ /dad pa'i me tog rgyas par 'gyur/ /ji bzhin gzigs pas thugs dag pa/ /blo mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro rnams thugs rjes mi gtong ba ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ba'i ) / /brtse chen khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /ji ltar 'bad kyang khyod kyi drin | | lon par 'gyur snyam mi bgyid de/ /gang gis khyod drin 'di 'dra zhes/ / rnam thar bsams na mchi ma dku/ /brgal bar 'os min nongs mi mnga'/ /dri ma med la 'thad pa can/ /rnam par dag la mtshan bzang ba/ khyod la gang gis lan lon 'gyur/ /'brel ba'i sgo nas mi bstod de/ /bka' drin sgo nas cis ma bstod | | gal te phyogs su lhung nyid na/ /bstod par gyur na smad pa'i gnas// du bas me bzhin rnam thar las/ /nang gi yon tan legs brtags te/ /grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa/

/'di 'dra kho nas bstod lags grang*/ /dad pa'i sgo nas rtabs tshul gyis/ /tshig gi sdeb sbyor btang snyoms gyur/ /tshig la dgyes pa'i mkhas rnams dang*/ /tshig gi mnga' bdag bzod par gsol/ /bdag nyid chen po blo gros rgya mtsho yi/ /yon tan me tog gus pas spel ba las/ /bsod nams grub pa gang yin de yis bdag /srid gsum bla ma'i go 'phang thob par shog | de ltar bstod 'di dpal ldan kun dga' yi/ /rgyal mtshan gyis spel 'di la gang dgyes pa/ /blo gsal de la bla ma'i thugs rje yi/ /ye shes gzigs pa'i ¡Ã byin rlabs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dam pa ) 'jug par gyur/ /'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la spyi bos reg pas shes bya'i dkyil 'khor la mnga' brnyes shing*/ gdung brgyud rnam par dag pa'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan la bstod pa brda sprod pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /b-ir+wa pa la bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ( ¡¶ lu ¡· na mo gu ru bh+ye/ ) dad pa'i chu las tshig gi me tog 'di/ /dpal ldan bir+wa grags pa'i zhabs pad la/ /gus pas gtor ro 'di las dge ba gang*/ /grub pa de yang sems can rnams la sby-in/ /dpal ldan khyed kyis shes bya 'di ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ni ) | | ma lus thugs su chud gyur nas/ /bstan bcos thams cad mdzad pa la// mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten kun gyi rgyan gyur te/ /shing rta chen po zhes su grags/ /dpal ldan chos skyong mtshan ldan pa/ /'jigs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ¡Ã shes bya kun la mnga' brnyes pas/ /rig pa lam mer kun tu gsal/ /rang gzhan rgol ba stong phrag gis/ /mi rdzi khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - shes bya 'tshal lo/ / ) 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba yis/ /nyin par dge 'dun legs bsdus nas/ /mtshan mo brtson pas grol brnyes pa/ / mtshungs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/

khyod kyi phrin las bsam mi khyab/ /de la gang gis bgrang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'gran ) bar nus/ /cha tsam gyis kyang bskal pa brgyar/ / rdzogs bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyis ji ltar mdzad pa yi/ /cha tsam 'jig rten mgon la bsnyad/ /des kyang khyod la gdams tshul gyis/ /bsngags pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mu stegs ston pa dregs ldan pa/ khyu mchog rnams kyis khyod thos nas/ /brgyal te dkon mchog gsum 'dzin par/ /'jug pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod kyi mtshan sngar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· yang ) chos skyong la/ /bir+wa pa zhes byin brlabs nas/ /thos pa tsam gyis sgrib pa kun/ /spong mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyod rjes bsgrub pa'i gang zag gis/ /ji ltar khyod sku rnam 'phrul dang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dag ) / /ldan ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· lhag ) par bsams te don ldan pa'i// mtshan tsam dran par byed na yang*/ /de la bdud rnams bye ba brgyas/ /glags rnyed ¡Ã lta zhig ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· par yang ) 'gyur re skan/ /de bas khyod las skyabs kyi mchog /med ces nges par bdag gis rtogs/ khyod ltar bsams te gzhan dag la/ /bka' lung btsal las mi 'da' zhes/ /'phrin gyis gdams par byas nas yang*/ /de yi sdug bsngal gtsubs pa'i me/ /gdon mi za bar zhi 'gyur te/ /'di la dkon mchog dpang po nus/ /de bas khyod las dam pa gzhan | | yod na gang yin bdag la gsungs/ /dkon mchog gsum las khyod gzhan med/ khyod las gzhan pa'i dkon mchog med/ /de las gzhan pa'i bla ma med/ /de bas lhag pa'i skyabs med pas/ /des na khyod kyis bye brag tu/ / 'gro la brtse phyir nyid kyi mtshan/ /thos pas sdig las ¡Ã rnam grol ( ¡¶ lu ¡· grol 'gyur ) bar/ /byin gyis brlab ba'i dam pa mdzad/ /de bas 'gro 'chag nyal ba dang | | 'dug na'ang rtag tu khyod dran pa/ /ji srid khyod mtshungs ma gyur par/ / de srid bdag ni mi gtong bas/ /'di la byin rlabs cis mi 'byung*/ /bla mas kyang ni de bzhin gnang*/

/gtan tshigs bzang po 'di la mthong*/ /des na bdag blo 'gyur ba med/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyod la 'dis/ /nyi ma re re gang bstod pa/ /de la'ang khyod kyis byin gyis brlab/ /gdon mi za bar 'jug par shog | rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa la gsol ba 'debs pa/ paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyan mtshan dpal bzang pos/ dpal sa skya'i ¡Ã gtsug lag khang du ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dgon par ) kha ton du bgyis pa'o// // ༄༅/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i 'phrin yig bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse ba dang ldan gzhan la phan dgongs shes bya kun la sgrib pa dang bral ye shes mnga' || mkha' ltar rnam dag nye bar zhi la lhun gyis grub pas dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i phrin las can/ /gang zhig rtag tu phongs pa kun skyob 'jig rten spyod pa dag las rnam grol ba/ /gsol ba btab na bslu ba med ldan ( ¡¶ lu ¡· pa ) rgyal dang de sras rnams la 'phrin 'di zhu/ /bde byed tshangs dbang lhar bcas 'jig rten gyis/ /gang gi snyan pa sa gsum rab bsgrags pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/ /swa sti thugs rje'i spyan ldan pa/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i ye shes can/ /'jig rten mngon sum gzigs pa la/ /mgon po bdag ni zhu bar 'tshal/ khyed kyis dang por byang chub thugs/ /gzhan gyi don slad kho nar bskyed/ /de rjes brtson pas grangs med gsum/ /lus dang srog la ltos med bsgrubs/ /de nas byang chub snying por khyod | | byang chub dam pa brnyes mdzad de/ /rnam grol chos kyi 'khor lo ni/ / rmad byung dam pa rab bskor nas/ /de nas khyod kyis dam pa'i chos/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun kun bsdus te/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /chos 'di khyod kyis ston pa yin/

/des na ( ¡¶ lu ¡· nas ) tshig don ma nyams par/ /nga yi bstan pa zung shig ces/ /sras kyi mchog la gtad mdzad de/ /lnga brgya tha ma'i bstan pa yang | | sde snod 'dzin pa rnams la gtad/ /de yi bsgrub pa'i bya ba kun/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten gtso bo dang*/ /sbyin bdag stobs can thams cad la/ /nan tan gyis ni legs gtad nas/ /mgon po mya ngan 'da' tshul bstan/ /de rjes 'phags pa'i gang zag dang*/ /so so skye bo mkhas pa dang*/ /chos rgyal rnams dang sbyin bdag ni/ /stobs ldan dad pa can rnams kyis/ /bstan pa yun ring gus pas bskyangs/ /deng sang snyigs ma'i dus 'di na/ /thub pa'i bstan pa phal cher nub | | chos mngon mdzod las gsungs pa ltar/ /ngan rtog rnams kyis bstan pa dkrugs/ khyad par du yang byang phyogs kyi/ kha ba can gyi bstan pa 'di/ /ngan rtog mun pas rnam par khyab/ /dge sbyong phal cher thos pa nyung*/ /thos pa de dag brtson pa nyung*/ /sdom brtson phal cher bkur ba nyung*/ /bkur ba de dag sdom brtson nyung*/ /sbyin bdag chos la dad pa nyung*/ /dad pa can gyi mchod bya dman// mchod pa de dag log 'tsho'i rgyu/ /gal te log 'tsho mi za ba'i/ /chos byed de dag dman dman 'dra/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dad na yang*/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /sangs rgyas gsung rab ngo mtshar can/ /de dag bzhi mdo'i rtswa bzhin dor/ /blun po rnams kyi brdzun tshig la/ /thub pa'i bka' bas gus par 'dzin | | bdag nyid chen po klu sgrub dang*/ /thogs med dang ni dbyig gi gnyen || phyogs kyi glang po chos grags sogs/ /mkhas pa rnams kyi gsung rab dang | | rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ /'phags pa lha sogs grub thob kyi/ / gsung rab yin par nges pa rnams/ /dug bzhin 'bad pas spangs nas ni/ / skyes bu rdzun mas sbyar ba yi/ /log rtog rnams la cher 'bad nas/ /grub thob rnams kyi gsung yin zhes/ /blun po rnams la rgyas par byed/

/'jig rten shes rab ldan pa dkon/ /bsod nams ldan pa shin tu nyung*/ /des na dam chos rin po che/ khyed kyi gsung rab 'dzin pa dkon/ /de ltar shes nas shākya yi/ /bstan pa nub par dogs pa dang*/ /bdag nyid legs par sbyang phyir dang*/ /gzhan la phan par bsams nas ni/ /lung dang rigs pa phal cher sbyangs/ /de yi stobs kyis chos kyi gnad/ /'khrul pa dang ni ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rnam gzhag cung zad bdag gis go /'di la rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras/ /mkhas pa sde snod 'dzin pa dang | | grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes bu mchog /mngon sum gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa | | de dag kun ni dpang po lags/ /des na bdag gi 'thad mi 'thad/ /re zhig gsan par mdzad du gsol/ khyed kyi gsung las 'di skad 'byung*/ /dge slong dag gam mkhas rnams kyis/ /bsregs bcad bdar ba'i gser bzhin du || yongs su brtags la nga yi bka'/ /blang bar bya yi gus phyir min/ /zhes gsungs gzhan yang mdo sde las/ /bstod 'os smad par mi bya zhing*/ /smad 'os bstod par mi bya zhes/ /gsungs pa de yang yid la bzhag

/slob dpaun rin chen 'byung gnas kyis/ /dad pa med pa gtso bo'i sgra/ /lhag dad shin tu gol ba'i gnas/ /gang phyir kun mkhyen tshad mas grub/ /gus pas kun mkhyen 'gyur ba min/ /zhes gsungs de yang bden par rtogs/ /de bzhin sde snod thams cad dang*/ /bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ /'khrul pa thams cad 'bad pas bkag /ma 'khrul ba rnams sgrub par mthong*/ /dam pa'i rnam thar bskyang 'dod nas/ /bdag kyang de yi rjes 'brangs te/ /chos kyi rnam dbye cung zad byas/ /de la blo gros ldan pa yi/ /sde snod 'dzin pa phal cher dga'/ / thos med blo gros bral ba yi/ /chags sdang can rnams phal cher smod/ /bdag gi lhag pa'i bsam pa la/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gzigs su gsol/ /gal te log par smra na ni/ khyed rnams kyis kyang bdag la khrel/ /'on te bden par smra na ni/ khyed kyi bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /sgra tshad sdeb sbyor snyan ngag dang | | tshig rgyan ming gi nges brjod sogs/ /shin tu mkhas pa rnams la grags || sde snod gsum po de sbyangs pa'i/ /sde snod 'dzin pa rnams kyis mkhyen// rgyud sde bzhi po de shes ( ¡¶ lu ¡· sbyangs ) pa'i/ /rgyud sde 'dzin rnams mkhyen par gsal | | de dag min pa'i chos gzhan ni/ /shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs pa med// de dag rnams kyi man ngag ni/ /rang rang gzhung dang mthun na yin/ /mi mthun pa de zab na yang*/ /sangs rgyas gsung dang ma 'brel phyir/ /mu stegs byed kyi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· rnams ) zab par 'gyur/ /rnam dbye 'di ltar 'thad mi 'thad/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis legs par dgongs/ /sgra la yi ge ming dang tshig /ngag dang rab tu byed pa sogs/ /chos kyi phung po'i bar du yang*/ /tshig bzang ba dang don brlings pa/ /bden pa dang ni snyan pa sogs/ /yon tan kun ldan thub pa'i gsung | | yi ge la ni ring thung dang*/ /shin tu ring dang mthug rkyang dang*/ /drag zhan dang ni lci yang dang*/ /u tad a nut+ta ra sogs/

/bod la grags pa med stobs kyis/ /phal cher dag pa shin tu nyung*/ /de la bdag gis ring thung sogs | | rnam dbye sgra dang mthun par bgyis/ /de la sgra sbyor mi shes pas/ / phal cher bdag la 'gal bar 'dzin/ /sdeb sbyor la ni lci yang dang*/ /ngal so'i gnas sogs gzhung lugs dang*/ /legs par bstun nas bkod pa la/ / sdeb sbyor med rnams the tshom za/ /tshig gi rgyan dang mngon brjod sogs/ / mkhas pa'i gzhung dang mthun par byas/ /de la blun po rgyab kyis phyogs/ /tshad ma'i mtshan nyid dbye bsdu dang*/ /mngon sum rjes su dpag pa la/ /snang ba dang ni sel ba dang*/ /'brel ba dang ni 'brel med sogs/ /sgra dang rtog pa 'jug tshul la/ /lung dang rigs pa mi 'gal zhing*/ /chos kyi grags pa'i sde bdun ltar | | bdag gis legs par brjod pa la/ /tshad ma ltar snang smra rnams rgol/ khyod kyi 'dul ba'i sde snod la/ /sdud mdzad phyi mas sde pa bzhi/ /skad rigs rnam pa bzhi dag gis/ /'dul ba lung rnams sde bzhir bsdus/ /de la sde pa bco brgyad kyis/ /gnang bkag mi 'dra sna tshogs gsungs/ /dang por len pa'i cho ga dang*/ /bar du bsrung ba'i gnang bkag dang*/ /tha mar sdom pa gtong tshul dang | | byin rlabs dang ni phyir bcos pa'i/ /cho ga'i bye brag thams cad la/ / sde pa bzhi po mi 'dra ba'i/ /rnam par dbye ba du ma mthong*/ /pha rol phyin dang gsang sngags kyi/ /theg pa'i rim pa'i dbye ba yis/ /sems can rjes su gzung ba'i phyir/ /gnang bkag dbye ba du ma snang*/ /de dag bdag gis lung bzhin bshad | | de la lung dang 'gal ba yi/ /ye bkag ye gnang zhes bya ba/ /'dod pa de dag bdag la gshe /don dam zhes bya'i byang chub sems/ /chos nyid kyis ni thob ces gsungs/ /cho ga gzhung las bshad pa med/ /de skad bdag gis bshad pa la/ /chags sdang yin zhes 'ga' zhig smra/ /kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las/ /skye phyir brda las 'byung bar gsungs/

/de la nyan thos theg chen gnyis | | nyan thos rtsa ba'i sde bzhi la/ /sems bskyed cho ga tha dad yod/ /theg chen pa la'ang sems tsam dang*/ /dbu ma'i sems bskyed rnam gnyis snang*/ / bdag gis de dag phye ste bshad/ /de la sde snod mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo phal cher bdag la rgol/ /de yi bslab par bya ba'i chos/ /bdag gzhan brje ba'i byang chub sems/ /lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs pa la/ /'jig rten pa dag bzhad gad byed/ /de yi bslab bya'i chos gzhan yang*/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bdag gis bsgrubs/ /'di la'ang bden par 'dzin pa dka'/ /deng sang sngags la mos pa mang*/ /gsang sngags slob pa shin tu nyung*/ /blo gsal rnams kyis 'bad na yang*/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa shes dka' na/ /blun po ma bslabs pa rnams kyis/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ga la shes/ /dang po mkhas pa mi bsten par | | phyi nas slob ma sdud pa mthong*/ /de yi stobs kyis gsang sngags la/ / nor ba'i rnam gzhag du ma mthong*/ /bdag gis bshad pa bden mi bden/ / rgyal ba sras bcas gsan du gsol/ /gal te gsang sngags mi bsgom na/ / dbang bskur med kyang 'gal ba med/ /gsang sngags bsgom la mos gyur na/ / ci nas dbang bskur dgos par gsungs/ /phyag rgya chen po thig le las/ / dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /dbang bskur med par 'chad byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma shi ma thag /dngos grub thob kyang dmyal bar skye/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /bla ma las ( ¡¶ lu ¡· la ) ni dbang nod zhu/ /zhes gsungs rdo rje phreng ba las/ /dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang*/ /slob dpon slob ma mtshungs par ni/ /shi nas ngu 'bod chen por ltung || zhes gsungs dam pa dang po las/ /dbang bskur med par rgyud 'chad dang | | sngags kyi de nyid sgom byed pa/ /de don legs par shes na yang*/

/ dmyal bar 'gyur gyis grol ba min/ /zhes gsungs de bzhin rgyud gzhan dang*// bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ /dbang bskur thob cing dam tshig ldan/ / de yis gsang sngags bsgom par gsungs/ /de skad khyed kyis gsungs pa yi/ / dgongs pa bdag gis bshad pa la/ /rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams rgol/ /cung zad shes kyang ma go ba'i/ /blun po rnams kyang bdag la gshe / ¡Ã de yang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ¡¶ lu ¡· deng sang ) blo ldan legs bslabs pa/ /mtshan nyid ldan pa'i slob dpon ni// dbang bskur mdzad pa nyung bar snang*/ /blun po cho ga mi shes pa/ /de dag rmongs pa'i tshogs bsdus nas/ /slob ma brgya stong du ma la/ /sbyor dngos rjes kyi cho ga kun | | nyams pa'i dbang bskur byed pa thos ( ¡¶ lu ¡· mthong ) / /de yi sngags dang ting 'dzin dang*/ /cho ga'i khyad par thams cad la/ khyod kyi gsung dang mthun pa med | | de la dngos grub ji ltar mchi/ khyed kyis gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ khyad par can gyi las rnams la/ /lha dus bya ba dus bzhin spyad/ /gzhan du cho ga nyams pa'i phyir/ /grub ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'grub ) pa nam yang yod ma yin/ /de la sogs pa'i gsung gis ni/ /cho ga cung zad 'khrul pa la'ang*/ /dngos grub 'byung bar ma gsungs na/ /deng sang thams cad 'khrul pa la/ /dngos grub 'dod pa bdud kyis bslus/ /de slad bdag gis cho ga kun/ /dag par bshad la khro ba mang*/ kha cig phag mo'i byin rlabs dang*/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur dang*/ /gtor ma'i dbang bskur la sogs pa/ /brdzun mas sbyar ba'i cho ga la/ /blun po 'jug pa smos ci dgos/ /sde snod 'dzin par rlom pa yi/ /snying med rnams kyang 'di la dad/ /'di 'dra gal te chos yin na/ /de las chos min gang zhig lags | | mdo rgyud kun las 'di ma gsungs/ kha cig gang zag dbang po rab || phag mo'i dbang gis smin zhes zer/ /gang zag rab 'bring thams cad la | | phag mo'i smin byed bshad pa med/ /gal te yod na khyod nyid dpang*/

/ las chog mgo la bzhag pa yis/ /dge slong 'gyur zhes zer ba dang*/ khyim pas mkhan slob byas pa la/ /bsnyen rdzogs 'byung zhes zer ba thos/ /'di la mkhas rnams bzhad gad byed/ /phag mo'i dbang bskur la sogs la/ /deng sang bzhad gad byed pa med/ /gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni/ /de 'dra'i rab byung cho ga dang | | 'di 'dra'i dbang bskur bshad pa med/ /de dag gnyis ka 'khrul pas na | | dam pa rnams kyis 'di ma byed/ /'di 'dra'i log rtog bkag pa la/ / chags sdang can rnams bdag la rgol/ /bdag gis smras pa bden mi bden/ / sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol/ /gzhan yang gangs ri'i khrod 'di na | | rab gnas sby-in sreg gtor ma dang*/ /ro sreg dang ni bdun tshigs dang*// bar do dang ni 'pho ba dang*/ /dmigs pa'i bye brag mang po la/ /da lta'i cho ga byed pa rnams/ /phal cher khyed kyi gsung dang 'gal/ /lhag chad nor ba mang po mthong | | de dag sangs rgyas bstan pa la/ /gnod par bsams nas bdag gis bkag /de la'ang mdo rgyud la sdang zhing*/ /bla ma ngan la gus pa yi/ /blun po phal cher bdag la smod/ /'di la'ang bdag tshig bden mi bden*/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams dgongs/ /rgyud sde bzhi po'i lag len yang*/ /deng sang 'chol bar spyod pa mang*/ /don yod zhags pa la sogs pa'i/ /cho ga bya ba'i rgyud kyi yin/ /de la rnal 'byor chen po yi/ /rim gnyis la sogs sbyor ba mthong | | de bzhin rgyud sde gzhan la yang*/ /cho ga 'chol bar byed pa mang*/ / dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs pa/ /dbus kyi gtso bo yul phyung nas/ /mi yi gzugs brnyan 'jog pa mthong*/ /sangs rgyas sku la sbyang gzhi dang*/ /sbyong byed 'phrod pa'i rten 'brel yod/ /mi yi lus la rten 'brel med/ /gal te bla ma sangs rgyas nyid/ /yin na sangs rgyas sku yis chog /min na sangs rgyas rnams kyi yul/ /phyung nas mi yi gzugs 'jog pa/ /sdig pa'i sa bon mi lci'am/

/ 'di 'dra'i lag len phyin ci log /ma bkag na ni bstan la gnod/ /bkag na gzhan gyi sems la gzan/ /gsung rab tshad mar mi byed na/ /dge slong dang ni dbang bskur la/ /sogs pa'i cho ga ci zhig dgos/ /gsung rab tshad mar byed na ni/ /dbang bskur la sogs cho ga rnams/ /mdo rgyud bzhin du cis mi byed/ / 'ga' zhig 'khrul par shes bzhin du/ /bsnyen bkur 'dod pa'i bsam pa yis | | cho ga thams cad 'khrul pa nyid/ /byed pa bdud kyis bslus pa yin/ / dam tshig dang ni sdom pa la/ /nor ba'i rnam gzhag mang po mthong*/ /de dag bkag la'ang khro ba mang*/ /'on kyang khyed nyid dpang po lags/ /bcom ldan khyod kyis gsang sngags lam/ /rim pa gnyis su bsdus te gsungs/ /de la rim gnyis mi dgos zhes/ /gsang sngags bsgom pa phal cher sgrogs/ /de dag khyed kyi gsung gis bkag /de la'ang de yi rigs can khro/ /bskyed rim bsgom pa phal cher yang*/ /sbyang gzhi sbyong byed legs 'phrod pa'i/ /cho ga'i rnam gzhag mi shes par/ /rang bzo'i dkrongs bskyed bsgom pa mthong*/ /bskyed rim gsal ba rab kyi mthar/ /son pa'i gang zag yang rab kyis/ /rdzogs rim gtso bor sbyang pa'i tshe/ /dkrongs bskyed gsungs kyi da lta min/ /dper na kha zas dkrongs bskyed la/ /sngaun du 'tshog chas mi dgos sam/ /sngon du tshogs sbyor ma bsgoms pa'i/ /bar chad med lam dkrongs bskyed dang*/ /sa bcu rim gyis ma bgrod par/ /rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin la/ /snyoms par 'jug pa mi srid bzhin | | bskyed pa'i rim pas ma sbyangs pa'i/ /lha sgom dkrongs bskyed de dang 'dra | | cho ga bzhin du sngags bzlas na/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub | | cho ga med na sngags bzang yang*/ /zlos par dgos pa chung bar gsungs | | rnam dag tshul bzhin shes pa yis/ /gtum mo ye shes skye ba'i thabs | | rnam dag med pa'i gtum mo ni/ /drod tsam skye yi ye shes min/

/drod skye ba yi gtum mo ni/ /mu stegs lugs yin nged kyi min/ /de bzhin rlung dang 'phrul 'khor sogs/ /mu stegs byed dang sangs rgyas pa'i/ /rnam gzhag mtshungs pa 'dra ba yod/ /gser dang ra gan 'byed pa la/ /'dris pa med na phyed pa dka'/ /phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yang*/ /dbang las byung ba'i ye shes dang | | rim gnyis ting 'dzin khyad par can/ /yin zhes khyed kyi gsung las 'byung | kha cig dkar po chig thub la/ /phyag rgya chen por ngo sprod byed/ /shor sa bzhi dang gol sa gsum/ /spangs la gnyug ma bsgom par bya/ /bram ze skud pa 'khal ba ltar/ /so ma ma bcos lhug par bzhag /'di la phyag rgya chen po zer// 'di don brtags na 'di ltar mthong*/ /so mar bzhag na bal nyid yin/ /skud par byas na bcos par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di la dpe skyon yod/ /don gyi skyon yang 'di ltar mthong*/ /gol sa gsum po bcad tsam gyis/ /phyag rgya chen por 'gyur na ni/ /nyan thos 'gog pa'ang der 'gyur ro/ /shor sa bzhi po spang snyam pa'i | | rnam rtog phyag rgya chen po min/ /rtog pa med na spong mi nus/ /rtog pa med kyang spong nus na/ /sems can kun la 'bad med par/ /phyag rgya chen po cis mi skye/ /des na phyag rgya chen po nyid/ /yin na shor sa gol sa med/ /yod na phyag rgya chen po min/ /de phyir 'di 'dra'i chos lugs kyi/ /phyag rgya chen po gsungs pa med/ /des na rgyud nas ma gsungs pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen po de ( ¡¶ lu ¡· nged ) mi 'dod/ /de skad bdag gis bsgrags pa la/ /rgyud sde mi shes pa rnams khro/ khro ba de dang bdag gang bden/ /rgyal ba sras bcas dgongs su gsol | | theg pa rim dgu'i rnam gzhag gi /'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la || rgyud sde'i rnam dbye mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo phal cher bdag sun 'byin/ /'di yang gang bden gang brdzun pa/ /'phags pa rnams kyis dgongs su gsol/ kha cig sangs rgyas gsung rab ni/

/nges don gcig pu kho na yin/ /dgongs pa dang ni ldem dgongs med/ /ji bzhin ji bzhin ma yin pa'i/ /sgra yang gnyis su gsungs pa med/ /gal te gsungs na sangs rgyas kyang*/ /brdzun gsung bar ni thal 'gyur zer ( ¡¶ lu ¡· zhes ) / /bdag gis drang don nges don la/ /sogs pa'i rnam gzhag legs par bshad/ /de la'ang sde snod mi shes pa'i/ /skye bo 'ga' zhig bdag la rgol/ /gang bden khyed kyis gzigs su gsol/ khyed kyis bde gshegs snying bo'i sgra/ kha cig nges pa'i don du bshad/ /bdag gis drang ba'i don du ni/ /lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs te bshad/ khyed kyis chos rnams dbu mar gsungs/ /yod dang med sogs mthar 'dzin bkag khyed kyis gsung bzhin bdag gis kyang*/ /'chad pa'i tshai yang yod med bkag /gnas lugs bsgom na'ang yod med grol/ /bsngo ba'i tshe na'ang yod med 'das/ /yod 'dzin la ni mtshan ma yi/ /dug can yin zhes khyed kyis gsungs/ /des na bdag gis bshad pa dang*/ /bsgom pa dang ni bsngo ba yang*/ /yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug

/spangs pa'i cho ga dug med bgyis/ /de la mu stegs grangs can dang || nyan thos thams cad yod smra'i lugs/ /'dod pa de dag bdag la rgol// 'di dag kyang ni bden mi bden/ khyod kyis rnam par phye ste gsungs/ /sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la/ /'ga' zhig sa lam mi dgos zer/ /la la gsang sngags phar phyin gnyis/ /mthun pa dang ni mi mthun pa'i/ /rnam dbye phal cher 'khrul pa mthong*/ /ma 'khrul pa yi rnam gzhag la/ /mdo rgyud rnams las 'byung ba bzhin/ /cha mthun khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /phyi nang sa lam bdag gis bshad | | u rgyan dzā lan dha ra dang*/ /gangs can tsa ri tra la sogs/ /phyi dang nang gi gnas chen rnams/ /sa bcu la sogs yin pa la/ /rgyud sde legs par ma bslabs pa'i/ /blun po rnams kyis der ma go /des na sa lam mi bgrod par | | yul chen tshol ba'i gang zag mang*/ /de dag khyed kyi gsung rab dang*/ / 'gal bar mthong nas bdag gis bkag /de la'ang de 'dra'i lugs can rnams | | bdag la rgyab kyis phyogs par snang*/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas sa lam yang | | nyan thos phar phyir gsang sngags la/ /'ga' zhig mthun zhing 'ga' zhig la/ /mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag zab mo yod/ /blun po rnams kyis 'di mi shes// bdag gis khyed kyi gsung bzhin bshad/ /de la'ang chags sdang can rnams khro/ / 'di dag su dang su bden pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan gyis gzigs su gsol/ /tshig gi sbyor ba 'chad pa la/ /'bru mang po dang de'i skyes bu/ /ba gnyis pa dang zlas dbye ba/ /gzhi mthun la sogs tshig sbyor ni/ /bdag gis sgra dang mthun par bshad | | legs par sbyar la bod skad du/ /mkhas pas sbyar ba thams cad dag | sgra mi shes pas bsgyur ba la/ /tshig don nor ba ci rigs mthong*/ /de 'dra bdag gis bcos nas bshad/ /ska cog sogs kyi bsgyur ba la/ /'ga' zhig sgra dang cung mi mthun/ /'ga' zhig don 'gyur dag tu byas/ /'ga' zhig brda rnying go ba dka'/ /'ga' zhig snga ma btsan par byas/

/la la gsar bcad dag gis bcos/ /la la rgya skad sor bzhag snang*/ /la la khams kyi bye brag gis | | rgya skad gcig la'ang bshad tshul gyis/ /bod kyi sgra 'gyur tha dad snang*// 'di 'dra'i tshig don 'dra mi 'dra/ /de dag legs par dpyis phyin pa/ /blun po rnams kyis lta ci smos/ /mkhas pa yis kyang shes par dka'/ /de dag bdag gi tha snyad la/ /sbyangs pa'i stobs kyis legs par shes/ /'on kyang skye bo chags sdang dang*/ /blun phyir bdag ni khyad du gsod/ /'di 'dra bdag gis shes ma shes/ /mgon po sras dang bcas pas mkhyen/ /'gro ba dam chos sun 'byin pa/ /de la 'jig rten phal cher bstod/ /bdag gis chos min sun phyung bas | | 'jig rten phal cher bdag la smod/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten thugs brtse la/ /'jig rten phal cher rjes mi 'jug /slu byed me tog mda' can gyi/ / rjes su 'jig rten 'di dag 'brang*/ /kye ma bsod nams dman pa'i mi/ /lha skal chad pas 'byung po sgrub/ /de ltar don dang tshig dag gis/ /'khrul dang ma 'khrul dpyad pa la/ /lung dang rigs pa mi 'gal bar/ /bdag gis dgag sgrub bgyis pa la/ /'jig rten phal cher chags sdang gi /bsams pas bdag la smod mod kyi/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan mnga' ba/ khyed ni bdag la dgyes par bsams/ /'phags pa klu sgrub 'di skad du/ /chos 'di de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /rtsod pa'i don du ma gsungs mod/ /'on kyang 'dis ni gzhan lta rnams/ /me yis bud shing bzhin du bsregs/ /zhes gsungs pa de thog tu bab/ /bdag kyang gzhan la khyad gsod pa'i/ /bsams pas bshad pa ma lags mod/ /'on kyang khyed kyi sde snod bzhin/ /bshad pas gzhan gyi chos lugs bsregs/ /thig skud drang por bzhag ( ¡¶ lu ¡· btab ) pa na/ /ya yo can rnams sems la gzan/ /de bzhin khyed kyi gsung bsgrubs pas/ /chos ltar bcos rnams mnyes ma gyur/ /bdag la chags sdang ma mchis mod/

/'on kyang bstan pa bsrung 'dod pas/ /bden par smras na pha rol khro/ /brdzun par smras na sdig pa lci/ /da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la/ /thal sbyar nas ni don 'di zhu | | bdag gis bden par smras lags sam/ /'on te brdzun par smra bar bgyi | | gal te bden par smras na ni/ /brdzun par smra ba thams cad khro/ /de ste brdzun par smras na ni/ khyed kyi gsung dang 'gal du dogs/ /gzhan yang bstan pa bsrung na ni/ /chos log thams cad sun dbyung 'tshal/ /'on te 'jig rten sems bsrung na/ /chos log la yang bstod 'tshal lo/ /bden par smras na gzhan sems bsregs/ /brdzun par smras na bstan pa 'jig /smra ba spangs na don mi rtogs/ /des na dam pa'i spyod pa dka'/ /e ḍa zhes bya'i drang srong mchog | de yis gsod pa'i mchod sbyin bkag /de tshe sha la dga' ba yi/ / gnod sbyin rnams kyis bsad ces grags/ / ¡Ã deng sang na yang yul de la/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - deng sang de la/ / ) e ḍa gtugs pa'i sa zhes zer/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po las/ / ) dam chos smra ba'i dge slong mchog /me tog zla mdzes thugs rje can | | dam chos bshad pa'i le lan gyis/ /rgyal pos chad pas bcad ces thos | | gzhan yang bden par smras pa'i rgyus/ /smra ba po la 'jig rten kun/ / log par 'jug pa mang lags pas/ /thugs rje mnga' bas bskyang du gsol/ / da ni phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas dgongs par zhu// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs/ /sems can rgud pa rnams la gzigs/ / bdud kyi las rnams bzlog tu gsol/ /rnam pa kun tu byin gyis rlobs/ /thun mong ba dang phul byung chos/ /rang gzhan don kun brnyes nas ni/ /sems can thams cad skyob mdzad pa/ /ston mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gcig tu bsdus pa 'jam pa'i dpal/ /dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan nas/ /bdag gi 'khrul pa'i dra ba bcad/

/yun ring dus nas 'di nyid ni/ khyod kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes/ /mkha' las de lta'i gsungs bsgrags pa/ /legs 'doms khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /la la sangs rgyas gsung rab bor/ /log lta'i mun pas khebs pa yang*/ /yang dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhes/ /rmongs pa phal cher gus pas bsten/ /skyon med yon tan dang ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung bzhin bsgrub pa yi/ /bla ma dam pa rnyed na yang | | 'jig rten 'di dag dad pa nyung*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ / 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /so so'i skye bo'i skur bstan pa/ /bdag gis legs par shes bzhin du/ /de lta na yang bdag rmongs pas/ /mthong yang rnam pa thams cad du/ /ma mthong ba dang 'dra bar gyur/ /las kyi bag chags shin tu sra | khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur ba/ /de don legs par brda 'phrod pa/ / de tshe som nyi med par gyur/ /gsung mchog khyod la spyis phyag 'tshal/ /sku tshe'i 'du byed gtong ba na/ /mgon po khyod kyi gsung rab mchog /nan tan gyis ni bka' stsal pa/ /'bad pas ci nus bsgrub pa'i tshe/ /bar du gcod pa'i chos de grol | | des na ji skad gsungs pa yi/ /bka' stsal de dag ci gsungs bzhin || rnam pa kun tu thog tu bab/ /bden gsung khyod la bdag skyabs mchi// las kyi chu bos bdas pa na/ /sems la rang dbang thob pa dka'/ /des na sdig pa'i dbang gyur pa'i/ /nyes pa bkru ba'i 'jug ngogs mchog /'jig rten mgon pos gzigs su gsol/ khyod la thal sbyar gus btud de/ /rkang gi khong nas 'jigs sems kyis/ /sdig pa de dag thams cad ni/ /yang nas yang du bshags par 'tshal/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams kyis/ /'gro ba kun gyi sdig pa yi/ /sa bon drung nas dbyung du gsol/ /thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs ldan pa'i/ /mgon po yud tsam dgongs su gsol/ /'gro ba shes rab mig dang bral | | yid brtan byams pa'i grogs kyis bslus/

/nyam nga'i lam du rnam par 'khyam | | sdug bsngal khur gyis shin tu non/ /phyogs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· grogs ) kun dgra bos khebs pas na/ kha skam mig rtsa zhan gyur pa/ /sdug pa'i smre sngags sna tshogs 'don/ /mgon med skyabs kyang ma mchis pa/ /'jig rten 'di la gzigs su gsol/ khyod kyis dang po 'di skad du/ /nga ni mgon med khyed cag gi | mgon du gyur zhes gsungs pa gang*/ /thugs dam brtan pa'i thugs rje can | | de la mgon med bdag cag skyabs/ /las kyi shugs kyis bzlog dka' ba'i/ /sdug bsngal chu bo shin tu 'jigs/ /mgon po bdag cag bsgral bar zhu/ /da dung bdag la zhu ba mchis/ /brtson 'grus brtan pas gzigs su gsol | | ma ga dhā dang ko sa la/ /bat+sa la dang yangs pa can/ /'phags rgyal dang ni 'khor mo 'jig /ser skya'i grong khyer la sogs pa/ /yul 'di'i gtsug lag khang dang ni/ /sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin rnams dang*/ khyod kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ /sems can rnams kyi bde sdug la/ /re zhig gzigs par mdzad du gsol/ /u rgyan dzā lan dha ra dang*/ /koṅka na dang sin dhu'i yul/ kha che dang ni kha sha sogs/ /ma kha dang ni li yi yul/ /de bzhin hor dang hor chen po// ha la shan dang nye ba'i ljongs/ /rgya nag rgya nag chen po dang*/ /gan+dha ra dang 'dod pa'i gzugs/ /zangs gling dang ni gser gyi gling*/ /zla ba'i gling dang seng ge'i gling | | bhad+ga ba raṇ+ḍa la sogs/ /lho dang nub na gnas pa'i ljongs/ /sngon ni khyod kyi bstan pa'i gzhi/ kha ba can gyi byang phyogs yul/ /thub pas bod dang bod chen zhes/ /yongs su bsgrags pa'i sa phyogs 'dir/ /nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur nas/ /lo ni nyis stong lnga brgya na/ /dam chos rgyas par 'gyur ces gsung*// der ni dam chos 'dzin pa dang*/ /klog dang kha ton byed pa dang*/ /nyan dang 'chad dang sgrub pa la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· yang ) / /nga yis spyan gyis gzigs so zhes/ /'gro mgon khyod kyis lung bstan mdzad/

/de lta mod kyi da lta yi/ /skye bo 'di dag bsod nams zhan/ /dus kyang shin tu snyigs mar gyur/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis/ khyod kyi bstan pa chud kyang gsan/ /de yi stobs kyis sems can rnams/ /shin tu brnag dka'i sdug bsngal myong*/ /rngon pas bdas pa'i ri dwags ltar/ /skrag pas mig rtsa rig rig po/ /'jigs pa'i dbang gis gom pa 'khyor/ /bkres pas lto ba rab tu rnyong*/ /rlung dang grang bas gdungs pa'i lus/ /'ga' zhig nad kyis rnam par bcom/ /la la'i nye du 'brel bas brlag /'ga' yi lam yang rnam par bkag /'ga' zhig shes pa 'thoms nas snang*/ /bsod zad rnams la gdon yang sdang*/ /sngon chad nyes par spyad pa yi/ /las ngan smin pa bdag cag la/ /sangs rgyas sras bcas gzigs su gsol/ /mi yi 'jig rten mtho ris zhes/ khyod kyis bde 'gro'i bsngags pa mdzad/ /'on kyang mtho ris sdug bsngal 'di/ /mgon po myur du skyabs 'tshal lo/ /gang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· gzhan ) la skyabs su mchis kyang ni/ /skyabs de dag gis bslu bar mthong*/ /bslu ba med pa skyabs kyi mchog /skyabs mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /sems can dmyal ba'i gnas la yang*/ /thugs rje ldan pas yud tsam gzigs/ /yang sos dang ni thig nag dang*/ /bsdus 'joms dang ni ngu 'bod sogs/ /mnar med srid pa bzod dka'i bar/ /mes bsregs mtshon cha'i char phab pas/ /nyam chung mkhun sgra 'byin pa tsam/ /sdug skad 'byin par mi nus pa/ /tsha ba'i sems dmyal rnams la gzigs/ /chu bur can sogs 'khyags pa yis/ /lus gas 'gul nyams ma mchis pa/ /'di 'dra'i sems dmyal ji ltar gso/ /mgon po yi dwags bkres skom gyis/ / gdungs pas yun ring nyam thag pa/ /bza' btung 'dod pa'i cho nge can/ /'di la ji ltar bgyi ba gsungs/ /brtse ldan thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dud 'grau'i gnas kyang gzigs su gsol/ /phan tshun za bas rnam par 'jigs/ / 'ga' zhig bsregs te gsod pa mthong*/

/'ga' zhig bzung nas rgyu lto 'byin// 'di la mgon pos thugs rje mdzod/ /lha min lha yi gnas na yang*/ /mtho ris sdug bsngal bsam las 'das/ /thog mar skyid pa bskyed bskyed nas/ /tha mar sdug bsngal gyis bcom ste/ /smre sngags 'don zhing ngan 'gror mchi/ /brtse ldan kun nas gzigs su gsol/ /sems can las la spyod pa la/ khyod kyi thugs rje mi 'jug na/ /'gro ba bde bar gnas pa la/ khyed kyi thugs rje 'jug lags sam | | sman pas nad pa gso ba dang*/ /mgron po dag la skyel ma dang*/ /long ba dag la dmigs bu dang*/ /phongs pa dag la sbyin bdag dang*/ /gsod par nges la'ang skyob pa mthong*/ /blun zhing snying rje shas chung ba/ /nus pa med pa'i skye bo yang*/ /'gro la phan phyir 'di 'dra yi/ /phan par brtson par bgyid lags na/ khyod ni zhi ba thams cad mkhyen/ /brtse bas sems can kun phan bzhed/ /nus pa dpag tu med mchis pa/ /des na phan 'dogs mdzad par rigs/ /'gro ba las kyi rnam smin la/ /spyod phyir phan par mi nus na/ /dang po las la 'jug pa nyid | | mgon po khyod kyis cis mi 'gegs/ /de yang dgag par mi spyod na/ / nga ni thams cad mkhyen pa zhes/ /'khaur gyi nang du seng ge'i sgra/ /bsgrags pa'i dgos pa ji ltar lags/ /'di 'dra'i skabs su mu stegs dang*/ /bdud kyi phyogs rnams rgol na ni/ /de la chos dang mthun pa'i lan/ /bdag gis ji ltar gdab par bgyi/ khyod ni byams dang snying rje sogs/ /tshad med bzhi yi thugs dang ldan/ /lha yi mig dang rdzu 'phrul sogs/ /mngon shes drug po thogs mi mnga' | | de slad byams sogs kyis bskyangs te/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni cis mi 'dul | | gdug pa can la rgyal sras kyis/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis ni ma bsdigs na// nyes pa yin zhes khyed nyid gsungs/ /cho 'phrul gsum la mnga' 'byor ba/ khyod la nyes pa 'di mnga' na/ /rgyal sras rnams la'ang mi mtshungs sam/

/gal te 'ga' zhig de skad 'dri/ /de la bdag gis ji skad gleng*/ /stobs bcu'i stobs dang ldan pa khyod/ /bdud kyi stobs kyang 'joms mdzad na/ /stobs chung rnams kyis gzhan 'tshe ba'i/ /stobs 'di khyod kyis cis mi 'joms/ /dbang bcu dag la dbang mdzad pa'i/ /mgon pos 'gro kun skyob mdzad na/ /'gro ba dbang med 'di dag la/ ¡Ã khyod kyi dbang 'byor ji ltar lags/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - khyod kyi ltar lags/ / ) med pa yongs su sprul pa dang*/ /yod pa gzhan du sgyur ba sogs/ / yongs su dag pa bzhi ldan pa/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin gyis/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa sel mdzad pa/ /'di ltar phongs pa gzigs nas ni/ /ting 'dzin de la 'jug tu gsol/ khyod kyi thugs rje chen po ni/ /'jig rten kun la lan drug gzigs/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' chos nyid kyang*/ /'gro ba'i don la rtag tu dgongs/ khyod ni nyon mongs mi mnga' ba// rang dang gzhan gyi nyon mongs 'joms/ /da lta'i 'gro ba nyon mongs pa/ / 'joms phyir khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin sogs

| | rnam pa kun tu brnyes khyod kyi/ /phrin las 'bad pa ci zhig 'tshal/ / de slad bdag cag rjes su bzung*/ /'jigs pa med pa'i chos bzhi brnyes/ /mu stegs gzhan gyis mi rdzi ba'i/ /'khor du seng ge'i sgra sgrogs pa/ /'jig rten kun la gsal bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kho na'i ma 'dres chos/ /drug phrag gnyis dang gsum gnyis ldan/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /bla ma khyod la bdag gsol 'debs/ /thabs mchog dag gis legs bsgrubs pa/ / chos nyid gzigs pa'i ye shes can/ khyod kyi phrin las mngon bsams na/ / bsam mi khyab pa 'di ltar snang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang du/ /sangs rgyas rnams la chos skur snang*/ /stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams su/ /rgyal sras mchog la longs skur ston/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas par/ /'gro la sprul pa sna tshogs 'gyed/ /skye ba'i sprul pa dga' ldan du/ /lha rnams gdul bar bya phyir bzhugs | | ¡Ã bzo yi sprul pas dri za yi/ /rgyal po rab dga' rnam par btul | | ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - bzo yi par btul/ / ) mchog gi sprul pa sna tshogs pas/ / gdul dka' 'ga' zhig gdul ba'i phyir/ /rnam pa sna tshogs ngo mtshar rmad/ / 'jig rten skyong rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /ri rab ri yi rtse mo ru/ /sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po der/ /dbang bskur mdzad nas rnam par btul/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje lha mo'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /mi yi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir/ /gzhon nu'i rol rtsed sna tshogs mdzad/ /dka' thub dka' ba sun dbyung phyir/ khyed kyis lo drug dka' ba spyad/ /rgyal po zas gtsang sngon rabs kyis/ /mgu mdzad khams drug bshigs nas btul/ /rgyal po chen po pi lin+da/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i gzugs kyis btul/ /rgyal po u tra ya na ni/ khyod sku ri mor bris pas btul/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi cho 'phrul gyis/ /lha dang bcas pa'i bdud kyi sde/

/btul nas chos kyis grol bar mdzad/ /rgyal po ma skyes dgra yi sdig /ras yug chen po'i gdams pas sbyangs/ /dge slong dgra bcom 'gro ba dang*/ /dmyal bar bskyur nas phyi nas gso/ /phyag na rdo rje stobs chen gyis/ /dbang phyug chen po bsad nas btul/ /bdud kyi dpung rnams bsdigs nas btul/ /lha mo nam gru bstod pas btul/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rje dang*/ /rig sngags sbyor ba'i cho ga dang*/ /ri lu sman gyi sbyor ba yis// sdug bsngal can rnams legs par gsos/ /de bzhin rgyal sras thugs rje can// cho 'phrul gsum gyis 'dul mdzad pa/ /de dag kun gyis 'jig rten 'di/ /bu gcig bzhin du bskyangs zhes grags/ /mnyan yod la sogs gdul dka' ba// gdul phyir shā ri'i bu la sogs/ /nyan thos chen po mngags pa mdzad/ /rigs dad bya phyir 'char ka dang*/ /yul can ( ¡¶ lu ¡· gzhan ) rgyal po gdul ba'i phyir/ / 'phags pa kā t+yā ya na sogs/ /gang la gang gis 'dul gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i tshul gyis thams cad btul/ /de lta'i phrin las bsam yas pa/ /mthong ngam thos par gyur na yang*/ /su zhig ngo mtshar skye mi 'gyur/ /sngon gyi phrin las de 'dra'i cha | | da lta'i 'gro ba nyam thag cing*/ /mgon med 'dren pa ma mchis pa/ /glen zhing phyogs kyang mi 'tshal ba/ /ri dwags rgya ru chud 'dra ba'i/ /sems can rnams la mi gzigs na/ /thugs rje mnga' ba'i thugs rje de/ /ji ltar lags pas gsung du gsol/ khyab 'jug 'jig rten phan 'dod pas/ /dga' byed dga' byed dgra sta can/ /mi yi seng ge mi thung sogs/ /rnam par 'phrul pa du ma yis/ /chos min byed pa'i gdug pa can/ /'bad pa chen pos btul zhes grags | | des ni 'phags pa'i chos ma thob/ /byang chub sems kyang ma bskyed mod | | 'on kyang phan pa'i spyod pa 'di/ /mgon po chen po gzigs su gsol// brgya byin gtsug na zla ba dang*/ /dbyig gi snying po byin za'i bdag

/nor lha klu rgyal ma dros pa/ /nor rgyas rgya mtsho'i rgyal po sogs/ /de dag 'phags pa'i chos ma thob/ /dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje med/ /de lta mod kyi rang rang gi / nus pa bzhin du gzhan la phan/ /nyi zla gza' skar ma bcol yang*/ /mkha' la rgyu zhing sa steng skyong*/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing*/ /sems med kyang ni re ba skong*/ /mgon khyod byang chub spyod pa'i tshe/ /lha yi dbang por 'khrungs pa na | | 'jig rten chang la dga' ba dag /'bad pa chen pos zlog par mdzad/ / tshangs pa'i rgyal por khyod 'khrungs tshe/ /log ltas zin pa'i rgyal po la/ /ngo mtshar can gyi skur bstan nas/ /de yi log lta bzlog ces gsungs/ /byang chub chen por gyur pa na/ /'bad pas rdzu 'phrul bsgrubs nas kyang*/ /mi dge'i bshes gnyen gyis zin pa'i/ /rgyal po 'khor bcas chos kyis btul/ /de la sogs pa skyes pa'i rabs/ /rnam pa sna tshogs rmad byung mdzad/ /'gro ba gzhan gyi srog skyob phyir/ /nyid kyi sku yang btang ba mtshar/ /mgon po khyod kyis rgyu yi dus | | 'jig rten chos las ma brgal yang*/ /byang chub spyod pa'i gnas skabs ni | | bdag cag phan pa du mas bskyangs/ /da ni 'bras bu mchog brnyes nas// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gzigs bzhin du/ /sdug bsngal can la mi gzigs pa/ khyod kyi thugs rje chen po gang*/ /nyam thag 'jigs pas bdas pas na/ khyed la skyabs su mchi zhing 'bros/ /'bros pa de bar thugs rje yi/ /spyan ras gzigs kyang ci zhig skyon/ /sems can las la spyod pa la/ khyod kyis phan par mi sbyor kyang | | 'on kyang sdug bsngal can de la/ /bka' tsam stsal na cir 'gyur lags | | 'jig rten pa dag ma phan yang*/ /sdug bsngal ldan pa'i sdug grogs bgyid | khyod kyis de yi cha tsam zhig /mdzad na'ang dbugs 'byin bgyid pa gsung | | de lta na yang kun mkhyen khyed/ /bdag cag 'gro la mi gzigs na/ / da ni skyob par byed pa yi/

/kye ma skyabs gzhan gang la bgyi/ /ji ltar sprul pa'i rgyal po 'ga'/ /thar bar bya phyir sprul pa brtson/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po sgyu ma yi/ / dpung gis 'jigs pa kun las sgrol/ /mgon po khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis/ / 'jigs pa kun las bsgral du gsol/ /mgon khyod kun la phan mdzad kyang*/ / bdud dang mu stegs dgra bzhin lta/ /lhas byin legs pa'i skar ma sogs/ / slob mar gyur kyang rgyab kyis phyogs/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pa/ /kun mkhyen gyis kyang mi mgu na/ /bdag 'dra ngan pas sems can don/ /bsgrub par 'dod pa bzhad gad gnas/ /na ba'i bu la khyad par du/ /ma ni gdung ba skye ba ltar/ /de bzhin rgyal ba sras bcas kyang*/ /dam pa min la khyad par brtse/ / de skad gsungs pa'i tshig khums pas/ /blun po bdag ni spobs pa skyes/ / bzhad gad mkhan gyis rgyal po la/ /ji ltar glaings kyang mi khro ba'i/ khrims 'di chos rgyal snga ma yis/ /'jig rten bde ba'i don du bcas/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zlos gar la/ khro rgyal thugs rje ldan pa yis/ /gnad du bskul nas sangs rgyas kun/ /nye bar byin gyis rlob ces gsung*/ /de ltar khums nas thugs rje can | | mgon po khyod la yang dang yang*/ /mi shes bzhin du zhu ba'i 'phrin/ / bdag ni spyi brtol skyes par gyur/ /de ltar zhu ba'i 'phrin yig 'di/ /gsan nas 'di yi 'phrin lan zhig /'gro la dngos su mi gsung yang*/ /'phrin gyis gdams par mdzad du gsol/ /mgon po khyod kyi yon tan 'tshal/ /bka' drin yang ni dran zhing mchis ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'tshal ) / /de slad zhing gi rdul snyed kyi/ /lus btud pas ni spyis phyag 'tshal/ /phyi nang gsang ba nyid don can/ /lus dang bla na med pa yi/ /mchod pa'i sprin ni mtha' yas pas/ /yon tan rgya mtshor mchod par bgyi/ /las kyi rlung gis 'das pas na/ /sdig pa'i rgya mtshor bdag cag ltung | | de slad nyes par spyad pa rnams/

/rnam pa kun tu bshags par 'tshal// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i slob ma dang*/ /rang rgyal dang ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis mdzad pa yi/ /bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo/ /'jig rten blun por gzigs nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mi mdzad/ /bdag cag lhag bcas 'jig rten rnams/ /chos gsung phyir na bskul bar gsol/ /sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnyed dka' bar/ /bstan phyir mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa/ /de la 'jig rten gnas kyi bar/ /'gro ba'i don du gzhugs su gsol/ /bslu ba mi mnga' skyabs kyi mchog /srid pa'i 'jigs pa skyob pa gsum/ /de la byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rnam pa kun tu bdag skyabs mchi/ /'gro kun bde la 'god slad du || sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag mchis te/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas | | spyod pa rgya mtshor spyad par bgyi/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba gzhan/ /yod med 'dzin pa'i dug spangs te/ /'jam dpal ji ltar dgyes pa yis/ /bsngo ba de bzhin bdag bsngo'o/ /da dung bdag la bsngo ba'i tshul/ /sngon chad gzhan gyis ma bsams pa'i/ /'gro ba'i phongs pa bskyab pa'i phyir/ /skyob pa mchog la bdag 'di zhu/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las mi 'da' zhes/ khyod kyi zhal gyis bzhes pa mtshar/ /de la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ / gang dag khyed kyi gdul bya min/ /de yi drung du bdag song ste/ /rnam 'phrul bye bas yid bsgyur nas/ khyod kyi bstan la 'jug par shog /gang zhig so sor ma brtags pa'i/ /btang snyoms khyod la mi mnga' mod/ /so sor brtags nas btang snyoms su/ /'jog pa khyod kyi gsung las byung*/ khyod kyis btang snyoms bzhag pa yi/ /'gro ba de dang de dag la/ /bdag gis 'bad pa chen po yis/ khyod kyi gdul byar 'gyur bar bgyi/ /gnas dang gnas min mkhyen khyod kyi/ / gnas ma yin la phrin las ldog /de dag mdun du bdag song ste/ /chos kyi snod du 'gyur bar bgyi/

/las ni bdag gir bya'o zhes/ /sdug bsngal tshor ba mi bzad pa/ /de la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dag ) thabs mkhas thugs rje dang*/ /ldan yang gso bya min zhes gsungs/ khyod kyis gso bya ma yin pa/ /de dag drung du bdag song ste || sdug bsngal bskyab par ma nus kyang*/ / ¡Ã de yi sdug grogs byed par shog/sems can rnams la phan dka' zhing*/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - de yi dka' zhing*/ / ) phan par byas kyang mgu dka' mod/ /gal te phan par ma gyur kyang*/ /de la brtse bas ston par shog /nyi ma shin tu 'od gsal yang*/ /mig dang bral la gsal mi nus | | rin chen 'byung khungs bzang po yang*/ /'bad rtsol med par thob par dka' | | phan par byed pa'i sman pa la/ /'byung pos zin pa shin tu khro/ /thugs rje mnga' ba khyod bzhugs kyang*/ /sdig can rnams kyis mthong bar dka'/ /rang nyid mun khungs zhugs nas ni/ /nyi ma'i 'od la 'khang ba ltar/ /de bzhin sd-ig pa'i khungs zhugs nas/ /phan mdzad khyod la 'khang bar zad/ /de 'dra'i blun po gzigs nas ni/ /mgon po rnam 'phrul bye ba brgyas/ /re re'i mdun du bskor nas ni/ /de ¡Ã dga' ba yi ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dag dga' ba'i ) chos bstan nas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad bsal du gsol/ /bdag kyang khyed kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /'gro ba gang dag mchis pa der/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las pas/ /lhag par gyur nas don byed shog /bdag gi zhu ba'i 'phrin yig 'di/ /ma brjod kyang ni thugs la gsal/ /'on kyang sems kyi zug rngu'i tshogs/ /bsal phyir khyed la 'phrin 'di zhu/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i chos smra ba/ /bden par smras na pha rol khro || brdzun pas sdig tu 'gyur dogs pa/ /de dag gis kyang 'phrin yig lags || bdag kyang sngon sbyangs las kyi 'phen pa yis/ /snyigs ma'i dus su ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'dir ) gangs ri'i khrod 'dir skyes/ /'on kyang khyed kyi thugs kyis rjes bzung bas/ /sangs rgyas bstan la dad pa'i blo gros skyes/

/de lta mod kyi khyod kyi gsung bsgrubs pas/ /skye bo phal cher bdag la mnyes ma gyur/ /'di la dgongs la khyed kyis gang bden pa/ /rnam par phye ste 'gro la gsal bar mdzod | | bdag kyang skye zhing skye ba thams cad du/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa 'dzin pa dang*/ /yang dag bla ma dam pa mnyes byed cing*/ /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs su 'gyur bar mdzod/ /dge ba 'di dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan/ / bdag dang gzhan gyis legs par gang bsgrubs pa/ /yod med la sogs dmigs pa'i dug spangs te/ /kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i rtsa lag thob par shog/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'phrin du zhu ba/ sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /skyes bu dam pa rnams la spring ba'i yi ge bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor/ /mkhas pa'i phyir na bden pa ston/ /mu stegs gzhan gyis mi bsgul ba'i/ /ston mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dam pa yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mngon sum gyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams ¡Ã bdag ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bdag cag ) gi dpang du gyur pa lags/ gzhan yang deng sang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos smra ba rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pas mos pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la don 'di zhu ba/ bdag gis rgya gar dang bod la yongs su grags pa'i sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi lung dang rigs pa dang*/ gdams ngag dang*/ rjes su gdams pa phal mo che thos shing 'dris par bgyis/ de la bdag gis bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa 'di ltar go bas/ 'thad mi 'thad legs par dpyad par zhu/ thog mar skyabs 'gro ma byas na/ sangs rgyas pa'i khongs su mi chud/ sems bskyed ma byas na/ theg pa chen po'i khongs su mi chud/

dbang bskur ma byas na gsang sngags pa'i khongs su mi chud par go / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + de yang*/ ) 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las | gang dag dge slong gi sdom pa ma thob pa de dag la dge slong gi ming mi gnas | byang chub ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + kyi ) mchog tu sems ma bskyed pa de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i ming mi gnas/ gang dag dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba ma byas pa de dag la gsang sngags pa'i ming mi gnas/ zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /des na chos kyi gzhi skyabs 'gro yin/ de yang thun mong gi skyabs 'gro la brten nas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa skye/ de lam gyi bden pas sbyangs na srid pa gsum na dgra bcom par 'gyur/ rang sangs rgyas kyang gzhi de la brten nas skyabs 'gro dang thabs kyi cha cung zad ¡Ã yod do/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· kyis khyad par du 'phags/ ) thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro la brten nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa skye/ sdom pa 'di sems bskyed kyi skabs su thob/ de lam pha rol ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + tu ) phyin pa drug gis sbyangs nas bskal pa grangs med gsum na 'tshang rgya/ 'di yang byang chub sems dpa' dbang po rno rtul gyi bye brag mang du mthong*/ bla na med pa'i skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed la brten nas/ rig pa 'dzin pa gsang sngags kyi sdom pa skye/ de dbang bskur gyi dus su thob kyi/ gzhan du thob par gsungs pa ma mthong*/ dbang bskur gyi sdom pa lam ṛm pa gnyis kyis sbyangs na ye shes phyag rgya chen po rtogs te/

rab tshe 'di la 'tshang rgya/ 'bring 'chi ka'am bar dor/ tha ma skye ba bdun nam bcu drug tshun chad na 'tshang rgya bar gsungs | des na/ dbang bskur mchog thob rdo rje yi/ /slob dpon la ni de bzhin gshegs/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pas/ /dus gsum du ni mngon phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa las/ dbang bskur thob pa'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rdo rje ) slob dpon la ji ltar lta bar bya/ zhes bya ba'i lan du dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + rdo rje ) slob dpon gyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig la mchod pa bsod nams mnyam par gsungs | thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba las kyang*/ gang la dbang rab mchog thob pa/ /de ni bla mar yongs su gzung*/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le las kyang*/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ /bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin | | zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /'di'i lung dang rigs pa rnams yi ge mangs kyis 'jigs nas 'dir ma bris so/ /des na sdom pa gsum gyi babs 'di ltar 'thad mi 'thad ngas bshad pa dang*/ mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa mthun mi mthun legs par dpyad par zhu/ bye brag tu so sor thar pa la yang nyan thos dang theg chen gnyis/ nyan thos la rtsa ba'i sde bzhi/ saṃ skṛ ta dang*/ pra kṛ ta dang*/ a ba bh+raṃ sha dang*/ pi shā tsi ka zhes bya ba skad rigs bzhi gsungs/ de las gyes pa'i sde pa bco brgyad snang*/ de dag la gnang bkag mi 'dra ba du ma mthong | ¡Ã de dag gi dang por len tshul dang*/ bar du bsrung tshul dang*/ gnang bkag gi dbye ba dang*/ tha mar gtong tshul dang*/ phyir bcos pa'i thabs rnams so so'i gzhung dang mthun par bya dgos kyi/ phan tshun bsrer mi rung zhes bdag gis bshad/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - de dag gis bshad/ ) bod du thams cad yod par smra ba'i 'dul ba min pa ma bsgyur/ lugs 'di 'thad mi 'thad/ sde pa tha dad bklag pa'i 'khor lo dang*/

'dul ba 'od ldan dang*/ spyod 'jug gi shes rab le'u dang | rnam bshad rigs pa dang*/ rtog ge 'bar ba la sogs pa nas gsungs pa dang*/ ngas bshad pa mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed la/ don dam sems bskyed bsgoms pa las skye bar gsungs kyi/ cho ga las skye bar gsungs pa bdag gis ma mthong*/ kun rdzob sems bskyed cho ga las skye bar gsungs/ de la'ang nyan thos kyi lugs te/ theg pa chen po pa mi 'dod | theg pa chen po pa la'ang sems tsam pa dang*/ dbu ma pa'i lugs gnyis snang | sems tsam pa'i lugs de/ slob dpon 'phags pa thogs med kyi bzhed pa | sdom pa nyi shu pa'i lugs/ da lta bka' gdams pas mdzad pa de yin/ de la so sor thar pa rigs bdun gang rung rten du dgos la sde snod kyi ma mo rnams shes dgos/ de dang mi ldan pa la sems bskyed bya bar ma gsungs/ dbu ma pa'i sems bskyed 'di/ 'phags pa klu sgrub ky-i lugs/ spyod 'jug nas 'byung ba chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i lugs de lags/ dbu ma pa'i lugs la so sor thar pa rigs bdun rten du mi dgos/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi ma mo mi shes kyang sems bskyed skye/ 'di dag gi cho ga dang*/ bslab bya'i khyad par rnams byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang*/ sdom pa nyi shu pa dang*/ bslab btus dang*/ spyod 'jug tu gsal/ nged zer ba dang gzhung du ma nas bshad pa mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur la/ rgyud sde bzhi la dbang bskur gyi babs mi 'dra ba bzhi snang*/ nang gses kyi dbye ba | dgyes rdor bde mchog la sogs tha dad pa cung zad mthong*/ spyir slob ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gsung thugs gcig tu bsres nas sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du mi 'bral ba'i rten 'brel bsgrig shes na/ dbang bskur phyin ci ma log pa thob par 'gyur/ de lta bu'i cho ga mi shes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/

chos sgo dang*/ gtor dbang la sogs pa smin byed kyi dbang bskur du bshad pa rgyud sde gang du yang ma mthong*/ bod kyis byas pa'i rgyud la yid rton med/ nged zer ba dang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i rgyud gnyis mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ rgya nag mkhan po na re/ 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyu rang ngo rang gis ma shes pas lan/ rang ngo rang gis shes na 'tshang rgya/ de'i phyir sems ngo 'phrod na dkar po chig thub yin/ 'di yi gzhung 'dzugs pa la sems ngo 'phrod pa na nyal bas chog zer nas/ bsam gtan nyal ba'i 'khor lo/ de'i gnad ston pa bsam gtan gyi lon/ de'i gegs sel ba la bsam gtan gyi yang lon/ de'i gdams ngag rigs pas sgrub pa la lta ba'i rgyab sha de lung gis sgrub pa la mdo sde brgyad cu khungs zhes bya ba bstan bcos lnga byas/ de'i lugs kyis chos la yang yas 'bab dang mas 'dzeg ces bya ba/ cig car ba dang*/ rim gyis pa'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ nged kyi 'di khyung nam mkha' las bab pa dang 'dra/ cig car ba yin zer ro/ /de dag ni slob dpon ka ma la shī las sun phyung nas/ dbu ma bsgom rim gsum dang*/ dbu ma snang ba la sogs pa'i bstan bcos chen po mdzad do/ /de nas rgyal po khri srong lde btsan gyis/ kho'i chos lugs rnams gter du sbas nas/ da slan chad bod kyi rgyal khams su dkar po chig thub su byed ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + pa ) la chad pa yod do zhes khrims bcas/ 'di dag gi lo rgyus rnams/ rgyal bzhed/ dba' bzhed/ 'bangs bzhed rnams mthun par snang*/ bdag gis kyang*/ slob dpon ka ma la shī la'i rjes su 'brangs nas bshad/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos kyi dgongs pa'ang 'di yin par mthong | ( ¡¶ lu ¡· go ) dkar po chig thub la shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa mi srid/ gsang sngags sam pha rol tu phyin pa'i lugs kyis thabs sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i stong pa nyid go bas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid grub par go /de'ang spyod 'jug las/

sna tshogs rkyen las byung ba yi/ /sgyu ma de yang sna tshogs nyid/ / rkyen gcig gis ni kun nus pa/ /gang na yang ni yod ma yin/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam 'grel las/ rnam pa du mar thabs mang po/ /yun ring dus su goms pa las | | de las skyon dang yon tan dag /rab tu gsal ba nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa ¡Ã du ma ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - du ma ) dang*/ brtse ldan sdug bsngal gzhom 'dod pas/ /thabs rnams la ni mngon sbyor mdzad/ /thabs byung de ni ( ¡¶ lu ¡· rgyu ) lkog gyur pa/ /de 'chad pa ni dka' ba yin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + mdo sde rgyan las/ ) ji ltar mdud pa'i bye brag gis/ /gos la tshon bkra mi bkra ba/ /de bzhin 'phen pa'i dbang gis na/ /grol ba'i ye shes bkra mi bkra// zhes bya ba dang*/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ thabs dang mi ldan ye shes dang*/ / bslab pa dag kyang gsungs pa ni/ /dpa' bo chen pos nyan thos rnams/ /de la gzhug pa'i phyir bshad do/ /gang dag dus gsum sangs rgyas rnams/ /thabs dang shes rab ldan pa la/ /bslabs nas bla med theg pa ni/ /'dus ma byas pa de 'thob bo/ /zhes gsungs la/ de bzhin du mdo sde dang rgyud sde/ bstan bcos chen po thams cad las kyang*/ thabs dang shes rab phun sum tshogs pa ma gtogs pa/ dkar pau chig thub kyis 'tshang rgya bar ¡Ã ma gsungs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bshad pa ma mthong ) / mdo rgyud las phyag gam bskor ba tsam dang*/ me tog re phul ba'am/ gzungs re bton pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan tsam brjod pa'am/ mos gus re byas pa'am/ snying rje re skyes pa'am/ stong nyid go ba tsam gyis 'tshang rgya bar gsungs pa yod mod kyi/ de dag ni dgongs pa dang*/ ldem dgongs su shes par bya'i | sgra drang po ma yin te/ mgon po byams pas/ don sgra ji bzhin yongs rtogs na/ /bdag nyid bsnyems shing blo nyams 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro | | dper na rgyu spun ma 'tshogs na za 'og gi ri mo mi 'byung la/

sa bon dang chu lud ma 'tshogs na/ zhing gi ston thog mi 'byung*/ rten 'brel thams cad ma 'tshogs na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'byung bar go /spyir sems ngo 'phrod pa dgos mod/ 'on kyang bzang ngan gnyis su ¡Ã snang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'gyur te ) / thabs kyis yon tan rdzogs nas sems ngo 'phrod na 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur la/ thabs kyis yon tan ma rdzogs par sems ngo 'phrod pa la ji ltar bzang yang*/ nyan thos kyi dgra bcom/ 'bring gzugs med kyi khams/ tha ma ngan song du skye bar gsungs/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ stong pa nyid la blta nyes na/ /shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa yang de la dgongs/ de bzhin du zhing la snye ma 'ong dgos kyang*/ 'ong lugs bzang ngan gnyis yod/ sdong bu rdzogs nas snye ma byung na lo legs 'byung*/ ma rdzogs par snye ma byung na lo nyes 'gro/ de bzhin du sems ngo 'phrod pa'ang*/ dus tshod la 'phrod pas chog dus ma yin par 'phrod pa la grogs med/ 'di dag la dgongs nas/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mdo las | blo sbyang ma byas sems can la/ /stong pa nyid ni sgrogs pa dang*/ /zhes blo ma sbyangs pa la stong pa nyid bshad pa la rtsa ltung 'byung na/ stong nyid go na smos ci dgos | dkon mchog brtsegs pa las/ shā ri'i bus chos bshad na dgra bcom lnga brgyar 'gro ba zhig 'jam dpal gyis chos gsungs pas/ dmyal ba pa lnga brgyar skyes pa'ang*/ yon tan ma rdzogs par sems ngo 'phrod pa dgag pa'i phyir gsungs pa yin/ des na rgyud las rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba gnyis gsungs pa ni/ bsnyen gnas la sogs pa'i sdom pa dang*/ nyan thos/ sems tsam | dbu ma'i lta ba la rim gyis sbyangs nas/ phyis dbang bskur bya ste/ lam rim gnyis la slob na/ rim gy-is pa zhes bya la/ dang po nyid du gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur te/ rim pa gnyis la slob ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + tu rung ) pa la cig car ba zhes zer te ( ¡¶ lu ¡·

gyi ) / deng sang grags pa'i rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba de lta bu mdo rgyud nas gsungs pa ma mthong*/ yang dang po lta ba bstan nas/ phyis spyod pa la rim gyis sbyor ba dang*/ dang po spyod pa la rim gyis sbyangs nas/ phyis lta ba ston pa'i bkri lugs gnyis snang ste/ 'di gnyis blo'i bye brag gis lam rim mi 'dra ba yin gyis/ 'di dag la rim gyis pa dang*/ cig car ba bshad pa ma mthong | spyir nged kyi bla ma chos rje sa skya pa chen po'i zhal nas/ bshad pa dang lag len gang byed kyang*/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang mthun na sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ mi mthun na bstan par mi 'gyur zhes gsungs/ nged kyis kyang de'i gsung bzhin 'bad nas bsgrub pa'i don lags/ lugs 'di 'thad mi 'thad rnam par dpyad par zhu/ yang bcom ldan 'das kyis mdo rgyud thams cad las/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod med kyi spros pa dang bral bar gsungs/ de'ang mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ mya ngan 'das pa'i chos la chos med de/ /gang phyir de yod nam yang yod ma yin/ /rtog bcas dag gis yod dang med ces bstan | | de ltar brtags pas sdug bsngal zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba mtha' yin te/ /gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang mtha' yin no | | de ltar mtha' gnyis rnam par spang bya ste/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ yod dang med ces bya ba rtsod pa ste/ / gtsang dang mi gtsang 'di yang rtsod pa yin/ /rtsod par 'gyur bas sdug bsngal zhi mi 'gyur/ /rtsod pa med par gyur na sdug bsngal zhi/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ yod ces bya ba rtag par 'dzin/ /med ces bya ba chad par lta/ /des na yod dang med pa la/ /mkhas pas gnas par mi bya'o/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ gnas med chos 'dis skrag gyur pas/ /skye bo gnas la mngon dga' zhing*/ /yod dang med las ma 'das pas/

/mi mkhas rnams ni phung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so// ¡Ã gzhan yang | yod med 'dzin pa las grol na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar 'gyur | | zhes gsungs so/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - gzhan yang*/ gsungs so/ / ) de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i mdo rgyud thams cad dang*/ bstan bcos chen po thams cad las/ yod med du 'dzin pa thams cad dgag par mthong | des na nged kyis kyang 'chad pa'i tshe na yang*/ yod med las 'das par bshad | bsgom pa'i tshe yang yod med las 'das par bsgom/ bsngo ba'i tshe na yang yod med las 'das par bsngo ba bgyis/ lugs 'di sde snod dang mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ chos kyi dbyings kyang dge sdig las grol bar gsungs/ de'ang slob dpon klu sgrub kyis/ shes pas yod dang med zhi'i phyir/ /sdig dang bsod nams las 'das pa/ /de yis bde 'gro ngan 'gro las/ /de ni thar pa dam par bshad/ /ces bya ba la sogs pa rgyas par gsungs so/ /'bum las kyang | chos kyi dbyings la yongs su bsngo ba med do/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa gsungs so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying ¡Ã po'ang ( ¡¶ lu ¡· po'i mdo dang ) / lang kar gshegs pa dang*/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa la sogs pa mdo bstan bcos las drang don la gsungs par mthong*/ nga zer ba dang mdo bstan bcos thams cad las gsungs pa gnyis mthun mi mthun dpyad par zhu/ gzhan yang nged kyis bshad pa'i lung dang rigs pa rnams dang*/ bod gzhan zer ba'i lung rigs mi 'dra ba mang du snang ba 'di'ang gang bden dpyad par zhu/ man ngag la'ang*/ dbang bzhi man ngag gi gnad dang*/ lam rim pa gnyis kyi gnad dang*/ ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i gnad la'ang*/ nga zer ba dang gzhan 'dod pa gnyis mi 'dra ba du ma snang*/ sa dang lam gyi rnam gzhag la yang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis kyi lam lnga dang*/ sa bcu'i bgrod lugs mi 'dra ba dang*/

phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel gyi rnam gzhag mi 'dra ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi sa la yang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par la'ang*/ nged 'dod pa dang gzhan zer ba gnyis mi 'dra ba'i khyad par du ma gda' bas/ 'di dag tshig dang don gyi rnam dbye shes pa | lung dang rigs pa'i gnad la mkhas pa/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi don la ma rmongs pa/ gzhung dang gdams ngag gi gnad mi 'gal bar nyams su len pa shes pa/ drang don dang nges don gyis mdo'i cha phyed pa/ ¡Ã dgongs pa dang ldem dgongs kyi gnad ma 'khrul bar thugs su chud pa/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang ji bzhin ma yin pa'i tshig 'chad shes pa'i mkhas pa/ don rnam par 'byed par nus pa'i shes rab can/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - dgongs pa rab can/ ) chags sdang med cing gzu bor gnas pa/ grub mtha' ngan pa'i gdon gyis blo ma bslad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis legs par gzigs la/ nged zer ba dang gzhan 'dod pa gnyis gang bden dpyad par zhu/ nges don gyi lung dang mi 'gal na/ drang don gyi lung dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ dngos po stobs zhugs kyi rigs pa dang mi 'gal na/ rigs pa ltar snang dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ rang gis khas blangs pa'i grub mtha' dang mi 'gal na/ gzhan gyis khas blangs pa'i grub mtha' dang 'gal yang mi skyon/ de'i rigs can thams cad mkhyen par byas la

( ¡¶ lu ¡· nas ) thugs kyis dpyad de dgongs par zhu/ ma dpyad par ri bong gi cal bzhin g.yam rgyugs su/ bden mi bden gyi dbye ba ma byas na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i babs la gnod pa dang*/ rang la sdig pa'i khur lci zhing mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhad gad du 'gyur bar go /dper na rgyal po'i bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + 'ang ) / yul brlag par 'gyur na/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na/ 'jig rten brlag par 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ de'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba la 'bad dgos/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bzhin gsungs na bla ma/ de'i gsung bzhin bsgrubs na slob ma/ de dag gi mthun pa'i yo byad bsgrubs na yon bdag de lta bu gang na yod pa de na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yod par shes par bya'o/ /'phrin 'di sangs rgyas bstan pa la | | mos pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa dang*/ /blo gros ldan pa'i mkhas rnams dang*/ / skye bo dam pa rnams la spring*/ /gal te bdag gi tshig bden na/ /dam pa rnams kyis legs zhes gsungs/ /'on te 'di la skyon chags na/ /lung dang rigs pas sun phyung shig /gal te bdag gi bden bzhin du/ /blun po thams cad kha 'dus nas/ /bdag la skur pa 'debs pa na/ /dam pa rnams kyis dgongs su gsol | | blun po rnams kyis dug zos nas/ /sman pa mkhas la khro ba ltar/ / blun po chos log spyod pa yis/ /mkhas la khro ba 'di re mtshar/ /des na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi/ /bstan pa phyi dro'i nyi ma 'dra/ /skye bo ngan pa'i 'ug pa dag / mgo bo bteg nas hung sgra 'byin/ /mkhas dang mkhas pa bsten pa'i sgrub pa po// sangs rgyas bstan la gces par gang 'dzin pa/ /de dag kun la bdag gis 'phrin 'di spring*/ /gzu bor gnas pa'i yid kyis legs par dpyod/ /sde snod 'dzin pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas skyes bu dam pa rnams la 'phrin du phul ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ / ¡Ã lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul bzhugs

( ¡¶ lu ¡· skyes bu dam pa rnams la 'phrin yig mdor bsdus ) / / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ / mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*/ /blang dor legs par 'byed pa'i blo gros can/ /tshul khrims legs srung lta ba dag pa can/ /kun dga'i ming can dge slong 'di skad smra/ /shākya seng ge'i bstan pa ni/ /'phags pa'i yul na rab tu gsal/ /de nas gangs ri'i khrod 'di ru/ /skad gnyis smra ba rnams kyis bsgyur | | dang po dag cing dar ba las/ /deng sang phal cher nub par gyur/ /de dag gsal bar byed 'dod pas/ /bdag gis sgra dang tshad ma dang*/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshig gi rgyan/ /sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi/ /phyi dang nang gi grub pa'i mtha'/ /yongs su grags pa phal cher thos/ /thos pa de dag legs par sbyangs | | grub mtha' 'khrul dang ma 'khrul ba'i/ /rnam par dbye ba mkhas pas mdzad | | de yi rjes su bdag gis kyang*/ /lung dang rigs pas cung zad dpyad || mu stegs byed kyi rtog ge la/ /rdzas dang bye brag yon tan spyi/ /'brel ba la sogs don la 'dod/ /bod kyi rtog ge ba rnams kyang*/ /phal cher de ltar 'dod pa yod/ /de dag bdag gis legs par bkag /de bzhin 'dul ba'i sde snod dang*/ /pha rol phyin dang mngon pa dang*/ /rnam rig dbu ma'i gzhung lugs dang*/ /gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi po la/ /'khrul par 'chad pa mang du thos | | thog mar skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ / ¡Ã so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang | | ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - so sor pa dang*/ / ) sems bskyed dang ni dbang bskur la'ang*// mdo rgyud dang ni mi mthun pa'i/ /cho ga mdzad pa cung zad mthong*/ /rim pa gnyis kyi ting 'dzin dang*/ /ye shes phyag rgya chen po dang*/ /rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs kyi/ /phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel dang*/ /sa dang lam gyi bgrod tshul la/ / thub pa'i gsung dang mi mthun pa'i/ /rnam par bshad pa 'ga' zhig mthong*/

/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + la la bdag gi sems bskyed dang*/ /bsngo ba sogs la gzhan dag gis/ /mdzad pa 'ga' zhig ma tshang skad/ /gzhung bzhin byas na chad pa med/ / ) de 'dra'i lugs kyi grub mtha' la/ /de dag 'thad dang mi 'thad ces/ /lung dang rigs pas rnam par dpyad/ /de la 'ga' zhig legs zhes zer/ /'ga' zhig mi 'thad ces su smra/ /'on kyang 'thad dam mi 'thad pa/ /shes rab ldan pas legs par dpyod/ /gal te rigs pas 'thad na blang*/ /de lta min na dor bar bya/ /len yang lung dang rigs pas blang*/ /lung yang nges don tshad mar gzung*/ /drang ba'i don la yid ma rton/ /rigs pa'ang dngos po stobs zhugs gzung*/ /rigs pa ltar snang snying po med/ /de ltar dgongs pa brtags nas ni/ /blang dor byed pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ /mu stegs gzhung dang rgan po'i lugs/ /gtsor byed blun po'i rnam thar yin/ /skye bo dam pas dam pa'i chos/ /chos lugs dam pa gzung bar bya/ / de ltar byas na dam pa'i chos/ /dgongs pa dam pa 'grub par 'gyur// //des na bdag gis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo rgyud dri ma med pa lung dang rigs pas grub pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis bshad pa/ grub thob rnams kyis bsgom pa/ 'phags pa rnams kyis bgrod par bya ba 'di bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung dang mthun zhing ¡Ã lung dang*/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - lung dang*/ ) rigs pas 'di ltar 'thad ces bshad kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i yid kyis bshad pa ma yin no || des na thams cad kyis bdag gis bshad pa 'di/ lung dang rigs pa dang mthun mi mthun gzu bo'i blos dpyad par zhu/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba 'di re zhig rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ /rtogs ldan rgyan po'i dris lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta chen po rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar phebs nas bzhugs pa'i tshe/ de na sgom byed kyin gnas pa'i rtogs ldan rgyan po zhes bya ba zhig gis chos rje pa la bskor ba dang phyag mang po byed cing 'dug pa la/

chos rje pa'i zhal nas/ rtogs ldan pa bskor phyag kyang ngo mtshar che ste/ gnas 'di 'dra na 'dug pa la gdams ngag zab mo la brten pa'i sgom sgrub cig dgos pa yin te ang gsung gin 'dug rtogs ldan pa des bsam mno zhig btang ste rang gi gnas nas dar yug dkar po zhig blangs te chos rje pa la phul nas/ chos rje pa lta ba phyag rgya chen po 'di theg pa thams cad kyi bsgom du bzhed dam/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ji lta bu lags | ci'i phyir phyag rgya chen po zhes bya/ 'di'i skye tshul dang*/ sa lam bgrod tshul gyi rim pa ji lta bu lags/ bdag la phyag rgya chen po'i gdams ngag zab mo zhig gnang bar zhu zhes zhu yin 'dug pa la/ chos rje pa thugs dges te/ ḍoṃ bi pa'i kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur mdzad nas/ phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes grub dang | tog tse pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi gdams ngag tshang ba gcig gnang nas/ nged kyi lugs kyi phyag rgya chen po'i khrid lugs 'di ltar yin/ grub thob ma snga bar rtse gcig tu bsgrub pa mdzod dang mi bslu bar yong*/ khyod kyis dris pa'i don mdor bsdus pa 'di rnams thugs la zhog gsungs nas/ spyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i lugs la lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum gyi lugs la zab gsal gnyis med kyi rgyas 'debs par bshad kyang*/ phyag rgya chen po'i tha snyad ma gsungs shing de dag gi lugs la mchog gi dngos grub bshad kyang phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub ma bshad pas | lta ba phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa bsgom par mi 'dod do/ /de dag gi lugs la rtogs bya stong pa nyid zab mo bshad kyang*/ rtogs byed thabs lam zab mo ma bshad pas phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa mi 'thad pa yin/ dper na nyan thos kyi lugs la sbyin pa dang tshul khrims la sogs pa bshad kyang*/ grogs thabs shes khyad par can ma bshad pas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa mi 'thad pa bzhin/

mi blun po la ba lang du 'dogs pa ltar/ de dag gi lta ba'i bsgom la phyag rgya chen por 'dogs pa ni ming tsam la mi brtsad/ phyag rgya chen po'i rang bzhin ni/ phyag rgya chen po mi 'gyur bde/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa dbyibs dag dang*/ /rtog dang brjod pa rnam par spangs/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang*/ /pra phab pa yi rang bzhin can/ /rnal 'byor thabs dang shes rab bdag/ e waṃ yi ge de la 'dud/ /phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ /pra phab pa yi rnam pa can | | rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /phyag rgya chen po de la 'dud/ /ces gsungs pa ltar rtogs bya chos nyid gnyug ma zhes bya ba rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid de/ rtogs tshul smra bsam brjod med kyi nyams pra phab pa'i rnam pa can gyi sgo nas rtogs bya'i ngo bor rnal 'byor zung 'jug gi ye shes de yang snang stong zung 'jug rig stong zung 'jug bde stong zung 'jug bde chen zung 'jug lhan skyes ye shes/ rang byung ye shes/ rang rig ye shes/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes zhes bya ba la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa de rtogs pa'i thabs/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/ bla ma legs par mnyes byas te/ /yang dag dbang bskur rab mnos nas/ /de nyid don ni rab tu dbye/ /zhes pa dang*/ brtag gnyis las/ phyi nas de nyid rab tu dbye/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar smin byed kyi dbang bskur mtshan nyid pa dang*/ grol byed kyi rim gnyis yan lag dang bcas pa tshul bzhin du bsgoms pa las 'byung ba yin te/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos bstan pa/ /rim pa gnyis la yang dag brten/ /gcig ni bskyed pa'i rim pa ste/ /gzhan ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa yin/ /zhes gsang sngags bla med kyi ye shes 'dren pa'i thabs thams cad rim pa gnyis su bsdus nas bshad pa'i gnad de yin no/

/phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba'i sgra don ni/ legs sbyar gyi skad la ma sbyangs pa dag phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te/ /rgya ni 'khor ba'i rgya las grol/ /zhes gsang rnying dang*/ phyag rgya chen po thig le sogs las 'byung zhes smra ba ni 'khrul pa ste/ legs sbyar gyi skad la ma hā mu drā zhes pa ni/ bod skad du ma hā chen po/ ¡Ã 'dir phyag gi skad dod med pa la rgyal pos bkas bcad kyi dbang gis/ sngon gyi lo tsā ba rnams kyis phyag zhes pa'i tshig bod skad la bsnan pa yin/ dper na bha ga wa te zhes pa la 'das pa'i skad dod med pa la bod skad la 'das zhes pa'i tshig bsnan pa bzhin no/ /des na 'dir rgyud las phyag gi bshad pa 'ong don med pa la phyag ni stong pa'i ye shes te/ zhes pa bod kyis byas pa'i brdzus ma yin/ phyag rgya chen po thig le sogs la tshig 'di dag med/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - 'dir phyag dag med/ ) mu drā rgya dang*/ rtags dang*/ mtshan ma dang*/ gug skyed la sogs pa la 'jug pa las/ 'dir rgya ru bsgyur ba yin no/ /don ni a wa dhū tī pas/ rgyas gdab phyir na rgya zhes te/ /srid gsum ro gcig phyag chen po/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang du rgyas btab nas nyams su len pa'i don gyi lta ba phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin no/ /skye tshul gyi rim pa ni/ gang zag skal bzang 'ga' zhig la dbang gi ye shes 'bebs pa'i dus nas phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa skye ba yang yod mod/ phal che ba ni thabs bsgom pa sogs la ltos shing*/ thog mar phyag rgya chen po ltar snang skyes nas/ phyis phyag rgya chen po mtshan nyid pa skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po ltar snang zhes bya ba yang cha mthun pa dug can dang*/ 'ba' zhig pa skyon can gnyis 'byung ba yin/ dug can ni thos bsam gyis bsdus pa'i go rtogs dang*/ bsgoms byung gis bsdus pa rnam rtog gi rba rlabs ma yal bzhin du zung 'jug gi nyams ban bun skyes pa yin/

'ba' zhig pa ni gnas pa 'ba' zhig ¡Ã pa dang*/ so sor rtog pa 'ba' zhig ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - pa dang*/ 'ba' zhig ) tu gyur pa dang*/ snang phyogs 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang | stong phyogs 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang*/ lus la bde drod dang*/ 'phar g.yo dang*/ ngag la nges med kyi smra brjod dang*/ sems la nges pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams snang sna tshogs pa ste sgo gsum gyi nyams 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa dang | brgyal ba dang tshogs drug 'gags pa la sogs pa'i nyi tshe ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa rnams yin/ sa lam bgrod tshul ni/ byang chub don du gnyer bas smin byed dbang bskur nas brtsams te nyams skyon can rnams rdzogs pa yan chad theg pa thun mong ba ltar na tshogs lam zhes bya ba yin/ brtag gnyis las/ kun mkhyen ye shes de lta bu/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bde stong zung 'jug gi ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes shing*/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i nyams rgyun chags su 'byung yang*/ rnam par rtog pa'i bag chags phra mo dang bcas pa nam langs nas nyi ma shar ba lta bu'i dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa ni sbyor ba'i lam zhes bya ba yin te/ mtshan brjod las/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ /ye shes gnyis med tshul 'chang ba/ /rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa phyag rgya chen po don gyi ye shes thog mar skyes pa'i tshe na mthong ba'i lam thob pa zhes bya ba yin/ de rgyun chags su goms shing gong nas gong du bgrod de sa bcu gnyis pa'i bar du phyin pa ni sgom pa'i lam zhes bya ba yin/ de nas sa bcu gsum pa mngon du byas pa na sku bzhi ye shes lnga la sogs pa yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu thob pa ni mi slob lam mngon sum du byas pa'o/ /de yang thun mong ba ltar na sbyor lam/

thun mong ma yin pa ltar na phyag rgya chen po dpe'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes nas don gyi ye shes mngon du byas pa dang/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'dir mngon du byed par 'dod na/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i spyod pa dang*/ nye rgyu sogs tshul bzhin du nyams len byas na/ rgya gar gyi grub thob rnams ltar tshe 'dir 'grub pa las 'os ci yod/ dpe'i ye shes mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes nas spyod pa ma grub na 'da' ka ma dang*/ bar do'i gdams ngag gis 'grub par bshad/ 'ga' zhig gis/ phyag rgya chen po chig chod la/ /sa lam rtsi ba'i rmongs pa 'khrul | | zhes bya ba ni 'khrul pa ste/ mtshan brjod las/ mgon po sa bcu'i dbang phyug ste/ /zhes bya ba dang*/ a bhi dha na las/ rab tu dga' dang dri ma med || de bzhin 'od byed 'od 'phro dang*/ /shin tu sbyangs dka' mngon du gyur/ / ring du song dang mi g.yo ba/ /legs pa'i blo gros chos kyi sprin/ /dpe med pa dang ye shes che/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bcu gsum pa/ /zhes sogs rgyud sde dang grub pa'i slob dpon rnams kyis sa lam gyi rnam gzhag rgya cher mdzad pa'i phyir ro/
