/ mtshan brjod las/ skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes gsungs pa ni | sa lam bgrod pa'i tha ma la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul yin/ 'da' ka ye shes las/ sems rtogs na sangs rgyas yin pas sangs rgyas gzhan du mi 'tshol ba'i 'du shes bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ni/ sa ra has | sems nyid gcig tu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa'i kun rdzob dang*/ don dam pa'i gnas tshul mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas sa lam bgrod de 'tshang rgya ba la dgongs pa yin/ ji skad du/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /rnam par shes pa'i gnas don nam/ /phyi rol gyur pa yod ma yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ rnam dag ye shes gzugs can dang*/ /'khor ba rnam par rtog pa la/ khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'khor 'das kyi snang ba thams cad sems su ro gcig pa'i gnad kyis yin/ rtogs ldan khyed kyis 'di dag thugs la zhog la sgrub pa mdzod dang*/ phan thogs pa chen po gcig 'ong gsungs nas ched gnyer mdzad cing 'dug rtogs ldan rgyan po la gdams pa phyag rgya chen po'i mig thur zhes bya ba chos rje pa'i gsung la yang yang nan chags byas nas bi jis ri bo rtse lngar bris pa'o// // ༄༅/ /rnel phu ba'i zhus lan bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dam pa'i don du chos rnams kun/ /rang bzhin gdod nas nye bar zhi/ /de la yod med dbye ba med/ /de phyir spros pa thams cad bral/ /don dam rtogs na 'khor ba dang*/ /mya ngan 'das pa gnyis su med/ /'jig rten pa yis 'khor ba dang*/ / mya ngan 'das pa gnyis su btags/ /yang dag zhu ba lung ston phyir/ /thams cad mkhyen la ye shes mnga'/

/chos dbyings spros bral brnyes pas na/ /ye shes med par gsungs pa'ang yod/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo sde las/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes ni/ /yod med mtha' las grol bar gsungs/ /sangs rgyas dgongs pa de nyid yin/ /drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don/ /mdo rgyud rnams la yod med de/ /gnyi ga med ces gang gsungs pa/ /de dag khyed kyis mkhyen par gsal | | rtogs ldan sgrub pa la brtson pa/ /bla ma la gus brtul zhugs can// dam pa khyed kyis dris pa'i lan/ /mdor bsdus pa 'di legs par dgongs/ / sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bla ma rnel phu ba la zhus lan du gsungs pa'o// // ༄༅/ /zhang lo tsā ba la gdams pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã oṃswasti sid+dhaṃ/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - oṃswasti sid+dhaṃ/ ) na maḥshrī mañju gho ṣā ya/ rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i/ /tshig gi me tog snyan tshig ze'u 'bru can | | blo gsal bung ba dga' ba'i dri 'byung ba'i/ /phreng mdzes 'di ni mkhas pa'i mgul rgyan yin/ /gang zhig dga' bas ring nas mngon dgongs shing*/ / yid gcugs gyur pas shin tu rjes 'brel ba/ khyed la rjes su gdams pa gang yin pa/ /'di la gzu bo'i yid kyis rnam par dpyod/ /mngon du gyur na dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur can/ /lkog tu song na rnam pa brgyas smod la/ /nye bar bstan na me ltar sreg pa yi/ /skye bo 'di la su zhig yid brtan 'cha'/ /rang lus 'di yang skad cig 'jig chos can/ /gus par byas na phyir zhing sred 'phel la/ / 'byor par gyur na ngan 'gro skyed pa'i gzhi/ /sems shes su zhig 'di la bdag tu 'dzin/ /blo gsal phal cher grags pa gtsor 'dzin la/ /dge sbyong tshogs kyang 'tsho ba'i rjes 'brang zhing*/ /mkhas pa rnams kyang tshig la zhen pas na/ /kye ma su zhig rgyal ba mnyes par byed/ /'dod ldan 'ga' zhig zang zing bsgrubs pas g.yengs/ /mi mkhas pa dag thos med sgrub pa'ang mthong*/ /mkhas pa 'ga' zhig bdag tu nga rgyal na/

/'di na phun tshogs skye bo su zhig yin/ khyod kyang rang gi rnam thar du ma zhig /sdom brtson dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs nang du | | dam bcas sgrub pa khas len ngo mtshar mod/ /g.yel bas lhod na nyams par gyur ta re/ /sgra yi rnam gzhag rtswa ltar dor nas ni/ /mkhas pa snga mas bsgyur ba zur bcos te/ /'phral skad tsam gyis gzhan gyi blo bsgyur ba/ /'di dag skad gnyis smra ba'i gzugs brnyan yin/ /rnam dag mkhas pa 'jug pa'i lam med par/ /grong pa'i skye bo pho mo 'dus nang du/ /zur gyis blta dang mgo kyog bzhad gad can/ /chags sdang rang bzo 'chad par dam pas khrel/ /zas dang ¡Ã nor ngor ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ngor dgas ) 'khor rnams dga' bskyed de/ /rnam par 'phyen pas na chung mgu bar byas/ /rnam 'phrul du mas log par 'tsho ba yi/ / dge ba'i bshes la byang chub thag re ring*/ /mang du thos pa'i 'od zer stong gsal zhing*/ /chags sdang gti mug sprin gyis ma bsgribs la/ /tshul khrims 'chal pa'i sgra gcan las grol ba'i/ /dam pa nyi ma de la bdag kyang dad/ /de slad mkhas rnams mgu bar 'dod na khyod/ /rang gis bsgrub par nus pa'i gzhung lugs gcig /tshig don bcas pa blo la nges pa dang*/ /sgrub dang gzhan la phan pa'i brtul zhugs zung*/ /bdag kyang brdzun gyis gzhan gyi blo bsgyur te || 'khor dang zang zing bsgrub pa mi dran mod/ /'on kyang 'dzem med smra ba'i ngang tshul bas/ /'di la 'gal gang khyod la bzod par gsol/ /dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas zhang lo tsā ba la gdams pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum pa'o// // ༄༅/ /bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ¡Ã 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | ( ¡¶ lu ¡· swasti/ ) bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la spring ba/ blo gros gsal ldan kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes bya bstan la phan 'dod cing | | mang du thos dang sbyangs pa mi chung ba/ /brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor ba des/

/gang na bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa la/ /rab dga' lha dang klu dang dri za dang*/ /grub pa rig 'dzin gtso bo mchis rnams la/ /ring nas dgongs pa'i 'phrin yig 'di spring ngo*/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron 'di thub pa yi// sngon du bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa na/ /da dung bka' mchid go skabs ma rnyed pas/ /bde bar bzhugs sam bstan la mnga' mdzad pa/ /bdag cag lus la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· lta ) bde bar mchis mod kyi/ /'on kyang bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yi/ /mjug tu skal ba ngan pa bdag skyes pas/ /sems la bde ba'i go skabs shin tu dka'/ /sangs rgyas 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pus/ /rjes su bstan pa dge legs rin chen gter/ /skye rgu'i phongs sel gtsug na rin po che || bstan pa 'di la rma 'byin shin tu mang*/ /lha min phyogs gyur lang tsho gsar bu can/ /ngur smrig 'chang ba bsrung bar khas blangs pa/ /bsam pa ma zhi nye bar ma dul ba'i/ /dpung tshogs 'dus nas lha rnams 'joms pa mthong*/ /skye bo'i tshogs kyi chu klung mang 'dus shing*/ /phyogs bzhi nor gyi nor bus rab gang ba/ / don mthun lto 'phye'i dbang pos nyer bsten pa'i/ /tshong dus rgya mtsho'i 'gram du g.yul ngo bkye/ /dge legs lha yi tshogs rnams gzhom bya'i phyir/ /da dung lha min rtsod pa yongs ma dor/ /grong dang grong khyer rol mtsho bdun po dang*/ / gnas dang dben gnas gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ /mkhan slob nyi zla'i 'od zer gzhom bya'i phyir/ /lkog gyur brdzun gyi sgra gcan mun pas bsgribs/ /der ni ( ¡¶ lu ¡· yang ) nyams dga'i bdud rtsi thob mod kyi/ /snyan pa'i mgo dang bral bas ma brlag gam/ /bdag cag rnams la snyan grags ga la zhes/ khrel dang bral rnams phyir zhing sred pa yis/ /gong nas gong du dpung tshogs cher bskyed nas/ / grags pa lha dbang rmang nas gzhom bya'i phyir/ /sun 'byin brtson rnams rdzi la lhun po'i rtser/

/mgo gcod rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ /dben gnas blta na sdug pa'i sgo bsdams nas/ /sa gzhi mig stong dag dang ldan pa la/ /ngo tsha khrel yod dor ba'i go gyon nas/ /grags min thob pa ¡Ã rno ba'i ( ¡¶ lu ¡· min pa'i ) mtshon thogs te/ /shes bzhin med pa'i zhe sdang chen po yis/ /rgyob sod sgra yi nga ro cher sgrogs shing*/ /thob shor yongs 'du'i ljon shing la dmigs nas/ / sdom brtson lha yi dbang po pham par byed/ /shing rta'i tshal du bzhon pa du ma rgyug/rtsub 'gyur tshal du 'khrug long du ma byed/ /'dres pa'i tshal du bya ba sna tshogs sgrub | | dga' ba'i tshal du bzhad gad dga' bas dgod/ /rang phyogs pham na mtshon cha nor bzhin len/ /pha rol bcom na rlung bzhin phyogs su 'phen/ /cung zad pham na ngo 'dzum sprin bzhin sdud/ /res 'ga' rgyal na nga rgyal 'brug ltar sgrogs | | 'ga' zhig grags na rnam 'gyur glog bzhin 'gyu/ /rjes su gdams na tshig ngan thog ltar 'bebs/ /de ltar mi mthun phyogs kyi phyogs gcig pa/ / chos la brgal ba dus la mi gnas shing*/ /tshogs pa tshangs par spyod pa stabs gcig tu/ /log blo'i go cha shin tu sra gyon pas/ /'di la lha yi rnga chen kun dga'i tshig /chos kyis mtho ba dus su brdungs mod kyang*/ /da dung gnas skabs shes par mi 'gyur zhing*/ /log par bya ba brtson par ma gyur gyis/ / 'di yis 'thab bral lha yi tshogs rnams dang*/ /sa steng 'og min bar du gnas pa'i lha/ /thams cad 'dus shing lha min 'di rnams gzhom/ /tshong dus rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bskrad par bya/ /'di dag btang snyoms bzhag pa'i 'os min mod | | gcig 'ga'i tshig gis bzlog par ma nus pas/ /thams cad ¡Ã thams cad phyogs phyogs ( ¡¶ lu ¡· phyogs dang phyogs mtshams ) kun nas 'dus/ /nan tur bsgrub pa'i tshig gis tshar gcod do/ /de ltar byas na bdag cag rnams kyi phyogs | | snyan pa'i 'od zer shin tu gsal ba dang*/

/rgyal ba'i rgyal rnga phyogs bcur thos pa dang*/ /yid bde'i rgyal srid yun du gnas par 'gyur/ /'phrin yig 'di ni gang gis thos mthong na/ /thams cad dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs te | | gcig la gcig gis lkog tu sgrog pa yi/ /bzhad gad sgra yis shin tu dga' bar shog /bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la spring ba zhes bya ba/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas sbyar ba'o// // ༄༅/ /tshigs su bcad pa gong 'og gnyis ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + grwa pa rnams la gdams pa tshigs su bcad pa thor bu gnyis ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ / ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + yang ) smras pa/ cung zad dben na rgyan po du ma 'gyed/ / bag tsam rnyed na kha la mchod par 'gyur ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'bul ) / /'ga' zhig mthong na tshig ngan sna tshogs smra/ /rgyu mtshan chung ngus 'khrug long du ma byed/ /rang gzhan rgyud rnams me ltar sreg par brtson/ /de la smras na khong nas rab tu 'khrug / glang chen myos pa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· 'dra ) lcags kyu med 'dra ba/ /grol ba gzhon nu rang la chags pa khyed/ /rgyal ba bye ba phrag brgyas bskor gyur kyang*/ /rjes su 'dzin pa'i nus pa yod re skan// //yang smras pa/ brgya tshar mnyan pas tshig tsam shes pa can/ /mang du bshad pas 'don pa goms pa po/ /legs par gtugs na bla ma dpang byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa 'di dag chu shing snying po 'dra/ /sgra dang tshad ma de bzhin sdeb sbyor dang*/ /snyan ngag zlos gar dang ni tshig gi rgyan/ /ming gi nges brjod dus sbyor dpe spel ba/ /legs rtogs byang phyogs 'di na kho bo tsam || kwa ye smra rnams phyogs yid ring spongs dang*/ /shes bya 'di kun shes pa lta zhog gi /gang gi bstan bcos ji ltar yod pa yang*/ /sngon chad khyod kyi blo la yod re skan/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i grangs su bgrang ba la/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + shes bya 'di dag legs par rtogs par dgos/ / ) gang gi phyogs tsam shes pa'i skye bo des/ / mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas zhes rlom mi bya// // ༄༅/ /mi nyag gi rgyal khams su gnang ba'i yi ge bzhugs/

/ ༄༅/ / ¡Ã oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ ) mi nyag gi rgyal khams na chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bla ma'i mchod gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che'i srog shing chen po gyur pa/ dpal sde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen por gnyug mar bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob zhal bzhugs pa rnams pas dbu mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu phul ba/ rnam dag chos rgyal 'byor pa'i chab kyis kun nas tha grur legs bltams shing*/ /mi mtshungs blo can mkhas pa'i me tog phyogs kun khyab pa'i 'dab ma can/ /sdom brtson dam pa bung ba'i tshogs kyis ( ¡¶ lu ¡· rnams ) legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i phyir bsten pa/ /sde chen bstan rtsa pad+mo'i 'byung gnas chu gter chen po rgyal gyur cig | de yi dge 'dun blo gros gsal ldan pa/ /tshul khrims dag pa'i dri ngad phyogs rnams su/ /rab ldang mkhyen brtse'i mche ba rno ba can/ /bdag nyid chen po spos kyi glang po khyod/ /'jig tshogs lta ba'i ral pa'i tshogs mang rab 'khrugs bag la nyal ba'i mig dmar ba/ /'dzin pa'i sbar mo rdo rje'i rtse ltar rno ba dang bcas kun nas ldang ba'i yan lag can/ /phra rgyas tshogs kyi mche bas rab gtams bdag tu 'dzin pa'i kha sgo kun nas phye/ /srid pa'i ri dwags rab bsnyegs mi mthun phyogs kyi phyugs bdag nye bar ma gyur cig khyed kyi rnam thar chen po'i chen po phyogs kun khyab pa'i snyan pa yi/ /grags pa rgya chen phul du byung ba skye bo'i tshogs kyis rab bsgrags pa/ /ring na gnas kyang mngon sum ji bzhin nye bar khums pas kho bo yi/ /dga' ba'i rgya mtsho dbyar gyi chu bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel bar gyur/ /de slad mchod 'os sdom brtson khyed rnams la/ / dga' ba'i yid kyis tshig gi me tog gi /phreng ba spel legs ngag gis rab brgyus pa/ /'di ni dge ba spel phyir bdag 'bul lo/

/bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin chen gter/ /'dul ba rgya mtsho'i nang na legs gnas pa/ /dge 'dun dge legs tshogs sgor 'jug rnams la/ /rjes su ston pa'i bshes gnyen ded dpon mchog /yan lag bzhi ldan dpung gis zhabs brtan zhing*/ / gdung rgyud dag pa'i spyi gtsug rab mtho ba/ /phas rgol 'joms pa'i rgyal po glang po che/ /yang dag lam 'dzud lcags kyu 'dzin pa po/ /dge legs char rgyun phyogs rnams kun khyab cing*/ /zab yangs chos kyi 'brug sgra stong sgrogs shing*/ / gdul bya'i lo tog shin tu rgyas mdzad pa/ /sdom brtson che khyed char sprin chen po lags | | mkhas pa'i ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + bu ) slob ¡Ã grwa'i ( ¡¶ lu ¡· grwa pa'i ) tshal du ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - du ) rab 'khrungs shing ( ¡¶ lu ¡· - shing ) / /dam pa'i legs bshad chab kyis legs bskrun pa/ /yon tan tshogs kyi me tog 'dab ma can/ /phan bde'i 'bras 'byin dpag bsam ljon shing khyed/ /sde pa kun gyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba ste/ / chos rgyal chen po'i gtsug gi nor bur gyur/ /dbang phyug rnams kyi mchod bya'i dam pa ste/ /mgon med rnams kyi dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing*/ /de slad khyed kyi mdzad par bgyi ba ni/ /da dung sdom brtson 'bum phrag lhag pa dang*/ /mkhas pa'i slob grwa brgya phrag du ma dang*/ /legs bshad tshol ba bye ba phrag 'ga' zhig/bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa spel ba dang*/ /yun ring rnyed dang bkur sti grags ldan pas/ /skye bo kun la sman

( ¡¶ lu ¡· gnas ) par bya ba'i phyir/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed kyis brtson par zhu/ /sdom brtson bde la legs par gnas bya'i phyir/ khrims su bya ba ji snyed yod pa kun/ /dgag sgrub tshul la gzu bo'i lam nyid kyis/ /rnam par dpyad na bstan pa 'phel lags grang*/ /mtshan ma cung zad mngon rtogs nyid byas nas/ /dge sbyong dag pa bsnyel bar mdzad lags na/ /rnam thar dag pa'i grangs su bgrang mod kyi/ /'on kyang 'thad pa rigs pa'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /dge sbyong lhod pa'i lus ngag ma bsdams shing || blo ngan thos pa'i nor dang mi ldan pa/ /'ga' zhig brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa yang*/ /bstan pa'i tsher mar 'gyur du dogs pa mchi/ /slob par 'dod pa'i dge sbyong blo gros can/ khrims kyis bsdams pa yul nas bgrod min pa/ / de dag 'khor dang 'byor pa lhan cig tu/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar btang na cis mi legs/ /shin tu mkhas kyang grags pa ma thob la/ /sbyin bdag nyung zhing 'khor dang mi ldan pa/ /de dag gtsug lag khang bzang sde chen gyi/ /so so'i 'chad por stsal na cir 'gyur lags/ /dbang po dul ba bslab pa'i khur 'dzin pa | | bsod snyoms rgyu bas kha zas mi 'phrod cing*/ /gnas mal gos dang sman gyis phongs pa yi/ /sdom brtson de dag bdag gir mdzad par gsol/ /mkhas pa mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba/ /che ba'i che ba bdag nyid che rnams la | | de skad gsol ba kun dga'i rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang po zhes byar grags pa de nyid lags/ /da dung zhu bar gsol ba mchis mod kyi/ /don mthun 'di dag 'gro bar 'dod pa dang*/ /bdag kyang rnam par g.yeng ba mang bas na// re zhig gus pa'i mtshan ma 'di 'bul gyis/ /brtse bas bdag dang bdag gi rjes 'brang ba/ /yul dang yul gzhan dag tu bgrod gyur ram/ /dus dang dus min ji ltar gnas kyang rung*/ /thugs rje'i thugs kyis rjes su 'dzin par zhu/ / dpal sde chen gyi gtsug lag khang chen por bzhugs pa'i mkhan slob rin po ches dbu mdzad dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu phul ba 'di ni/

dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par gnas pa/ shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bya bas gsol ba lags/ yi ge mi 'khyar pa'i rten kha che'i gur gum zho bcu gsum 'bul// // ༄༅/ /nyi ma la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ nyi ma la spring ba/ nyon mongs kyis sngo ngad pas stong pa'i rang bzhin nam mkha'i khongs su lang tsho rgyas pa'i sprin 'dus pa/ /ngan rtog rlung dmar phyogs rnams kun 'khrug rnam 'gyur glog ltar 'gyu bas rang gi rang bzhin gsal byed cing*/ /tshig ngan ser ba rtsub spyod rdo rje'i char 'bebs dge legs lo tog thar pa'i khang bzang rab 'joms pa'i/ /'jigs chen 'di la yon tan bang mdzod 'phel 'dod dpal ldan sa skyar gnas rnams bsrung bar cis mi brtson// // ༄༅/ /sho dgon pa 'gro mgon rin chen la spṛng ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden par smra ba 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor/ /'dus pa'i gtsug na stong nyid seng ge'i sgra/ /rdul bral dpag yas 'jam pa'i yan lag gis/ /sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba'i gsung rab ji bzhin chos smra zhing*/ / grub pa mchog brnyes du ma bzhugs pa'i gzhi/ /dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon par legs gnas pa/ /sde snod 'dzin pa de yi spring yig 'di/ /dam pa'i gdan sa dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /rtogs ldan 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis rab gang ba | | grub pa'i gnas mchog sho dgon dben gnas su/ /bzhugs pa'i 'gro mgon rin chen phyag tu 'bul/ /dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas zhing khams rnam par dag pa/ shar phyogs kyi rgyud sa gzhi dgos 'dod 'byung ba smar khams kyi cha | chu klung dal gyis 'bab pa zla chab dkar mo'i ngogs/ phyogs kun nas rin po che'i gter khang du ma dang ldan zhing*/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi 'byung khungs/ khor yug gi ri bo rab tu mtho zhing*/

sa gzhi yid du 'ong ba lhun po'i ngos la 'jam pa'i spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs kyis mdzes par snang ba tsan+dan gyi nags tshal/ yal ga dang lo 'dab me tog dang 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas mdzes pa'i bya rnams snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa dang bcas pas/ dga' ba'i tshal kun tu brgyan pa ltar/ lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyang yid 'dzin par byed pa'i gnas/ nyams myong dang rtogs pa 'phel bar byed pa'i dben gnas dam pa/ dpal gyi sho dgon na bzhugs pa/ tshul khrims dang bsgrub pa phun sum tshogs shing*/ rtogs pa dang mkhyen brtse'i yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rin po che gdan sa ba'i phyag tu 'bul ba/ khyed kyis bla ma dam pa rnams la sangs rgyas su 'dzin pa'i rnam par thar pa dang ldan pas/ chos rje sa skya pa chen po'i zhabs drung du rin po che phag mo grub pas gtugs/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pa mnos pa'i dbang gis nged la yang brgyud pa'i bla mar bzung nas/ nged kyi bu slob rnams kyi bdag gnyer mdzad cing*/ bstan pa'i srog shing du bzhugs nas sa skya pa dang khyad med du mdzad bya ba khyed rang gi slob ma ston pa tshul gzhon ngag las thos/ de la dga' zhing rjes su yi rangs/ slad ma nged la hor gyi rgyal pos bla mchod la 'ong dgos bya ba'i gdan 'dren nan can yang yang byung bas da lo 'gro ba lags/ khyed kyis kyang rgyal po'i bla mchod rgyu dang*/ mi go chod 'ga' 'dab nor dang nged kyi zla la btang nas rgyal po'i gser yig dang 'ja' sa zhus na ngo lta brtan pa yin pas thugs la 'thad na nges rogs ldan gang dgos byed pa lags/ nged gar yod kyi sngon la mi thong*/ khyed kyi slob ma ston tshul la sogs pa kun yang yon tan che bar yod/ khyed la yang mos gus dang re gnyis ka che bar gda'/ khyed bstan pa'i sgor zhugs tshad rnams la sku gces pa nya dang tshes brgyad byung ngo cog la rnam rgyal stong mchod mang ba re mdzad par zhu/

yig rten du nged la yā tse rgyal pos khong rang gi thugs dam du bzhengs nas nged la phul ba'i gser sdud yig shog khyad par du 'phags shing*/ glegs shing gi rgyab rkos la yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang*/ ldum rdzings dang*/ pa tra la sogs pa bzo gnas khyad par 'phags pa du ma dang ldan pa/ tso'u zi dmar po dang*/ be'u ras dkar po'i na bza' can gnag 'bum cig dang do mnyam zer ba zhig thugs dam du 'bul/ gzhan du mi gtang bar zhu/ ras dar tshon ma ya ba legs pa zhig dang*/ ka ra'i glang po che zhig 'bul zhing mchis/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas bskyed pa'i yum/ /bdag 'dzin bud shing bsreg pa'i ye shes me/ /ma rig mun pa bsal byed rin chen sgron/ /zab mo'i don ston gsung rab dri ma med | | sdug bsngal nad kun sel byed sman gyi mchog /zhal gsung pha rol phyin gzhung sum brgya pa/ /mthing shog gzhi la gser yig khyad par 'phags/ / glegs shing ngos la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sku/ /'dzam bu'i gser las bzo gnas du mas brgyan/ /dbus gtsang mthil na khyad par 'phags pa 'di/ /dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'du ba'i pho brang du/ /mi mchog khyed la mchod pa'i rten du 'bul// ka shi'i ras dang ka ra'i glang po mchog /dngos po shin tu phra bar gyur na yang*/ / dga' ba'i yid kyis ring nas bskur ba 'di/ /mos pa'i stobs kyis phyag tu phyin nas kyang*/ /dwangs shing dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bzhes nas su/ /gzhan phan thugs las chung la mi gzhol zhu/ /'dir smras pa/ rtogs pa zla mdzes yon tan dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /phrin las bsil 'od nyon mongs gdung ba sel/ / slob ma kun+da'i tshal rab rgyas mdzad pa/ /skyes mchog ri bong 'dzin pa rgyal gyur cig | dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅/ /sho dgon gyi dge 'dun rnams la spring ba bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/

bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter yon tan pad+mo'i tshal/ /phan bde'i dri bzang dge 'dun bung bas bsten/ /ting 'dzin sbrang rtsis skye rgu'i gdung sel ba/ /'gro ba'i bla ma rtag tu rgyal gyur cig /dam pa dam pa'i skye bo 'du ba'i gnas/ /bde gshegs bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan 'dzin pa/ /dben gnas dben la dga' ba 'du ba'i gzhi/ /dgon pa'i dam pa sho dgon zhes su grags/ /der gnas dge 'dun rnams la don 'di spring*/ /sdom brtson dam pa ting 'dzin mchog brnyes pa || yang dag lam ston 'gro la bu bzhin brtse/ /bstan pa'i mdzod 'dzin bla ma dam pa de/ /zhi bar gshegs zhes bdag gis ring nas khums/ /de la gshegs dang bzhugs pa yongs mi mnga'/ /gshegs dang bzhugs pa 'jig rten blun pos btags/ /dam pa'i don du chos rnams nye bar zhi/ /brtson ldan khyed kyis don 'di legs mkhyen mod/ /'on kyang snyigs dus bsod nams zhan pa dang*/ /rtsod pa'i dus kyi 'gro ba blun pas na/ /dam pa'i don la dpyod pa zhan pa'i phyir/ /'das pa yin zhes gdung ba mi bzad skye/ /'khrul pa'i snang ngor bde gshegs bstan pa yang*/ /ston ka'i char bzhin kun nas 'bri ba mthong*/ / skye bo dam pa'i 'bras bu phal cher yang*/ /dus kyi shugs kyis rnam par ltung bar snang*/ /de yi slad du dge 'dun rnams/ /dngos po'i chos nyid mkhyen pas na | | rnam pa kun tu thugs gtod ces/ /ring nas gnas pa bdag gsol 'debs | | dpal ldan sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ /shar phyogs kyi sa'i cha gnam 'phang mtho zhing rgyar yangs la yid du 'ong ba/ ri bo chen po rin po che 'bar ba lta bu'i ngogs | rtsi shing dang nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ mdzes pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang*/ sgra snyan pa'i bya du mas gang ba/ grub pa thob pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsten pa'i gnas/ dpal gyi sho dgon na bzhugs pa'i rin chen gdan sa bas dbu mdzad dge 'dun rnams kyi phyag tu spring ba/

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la gcig tu gzhol ba/ 'gro ba thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse ba'i ngang tshul can bla ma dam pa de la 'das grongs mi mnga' yang*/ skye bo rtag 'dzin can rnams drang ba'i phyir/ bde ba nas bde bar gshegs pa de/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams dmas shing*/ sems can rnams mgon dang bral ba yin mod kyi/ 'on kyang yang dag pa'i don la dgongs la thugs khral mi mdzad par zhu// //rdzas dang bkur sti la sogs pa'ang*/ /mchod pa'i khyad par yin mod kyi | | yang dag bla ma dam pa la/ /bsgrub pa'i mchod pa de bas lhag /de slad tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir/ /sdom brtson dge 'dun khyed rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa dang*/ /bla ma dam pa mnyes bya'i phyir/ /yang dag brtul zhugs brtan pa yis/ /rnam pa kun tu brtson mdzad na/ /bla ma thub pa mnyes par 'gyur/ /spring yig tsha zer byed pa'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mun pa'i tshogs bsal te/ /dge 'dun pad+mo'i tshogs rnams rgyas byed cing*/ /bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gsal gyur cig /byang chub snying po dam par byang chub pa/ /mnyam med de ni chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed/ /log ltung mgon med phongs pa'i skyabs gyur pa/ / kun mkhyen 'gro mgon de yi zhabs la 'dud/ /yon tan dpag med chab kyis legs gang zhing*/ /lung rigs man ngag rin chen gter gyis phyug /yid bzhin mtsho 'dra dpal ldan sa skya nas/ /mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*// blang dor legs par phyed pa'i shes rab ldan/ /tshul khrims legs bsrungs lta ba dag pa can/ /sde snod 'dzin pa de yi spring yig 'di/ /byams pa'i thugs dgongs phan bde'i phrin las can/ /shar phyogs smar khams zhing na legs bzhugs pa/ /sde dgon yon mchod rnams kyi phyag tu phul// // ༄༅/ /bod yul la bsngags pa bzhugs/

/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yis/ /'gro ba'i bla ma'i zhabs kyi ze'u 'bru la/ /nyi zer phra ba'i cha shas 'jug pa ltar/ /g.yeng ba med par rtse gcig gis btud pa | | bdag kyang ji ltar nus pas rdzogs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas tshig gi phreng bas bstod bgyi ste/ /sa steng dpag bsam ljon shing rab bskyed ces/ /lcug phran myu gu'i tshogs rnams cis mi skyed/ /dbus kyi gling chen po bzhi pa/ bye brag tu 'dzam bu'i gling*/ bde bar gshegs pa rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi reg pas mngon par chos rje sa paṇa gsung rab dpe bsdur ma pod dang po/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ sa skya bka' 'bum/ PAGE 358PAGE 357
